AccountDaysTTL.desc: Time to live in days of the current account

params.days: This account will self-destruct in the specified number of days

AiComposeTone.desc: A custom `AI composer tone  <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`__, used to rephrase messages in a specific style with the `AI message composer <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#compose-messages>`__.

params.author_id: ID of the user that created this tone, if made public by the author.
params.creator: Whether the current user is the creator of this tone
params.emoji_id: `Custom emoji ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`__ of the tone's icon
params.example_english: An example showing how a sample English message is rephrased by this tone; use `aicompose.getToneExample <https://core.telegram.org/method/aicompose.getToneExample>`__ to fetch more examples.
params.installs_count: Number of users that have installed this tone
params.prompt: The prompt that describes how the AI should rephrase messages using this tone, up to `aicompose_tone_prompt_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-prompt-length-max>`__ UTF-8 characters long; only present for tones created by the current user
params.slug: Unique tone slug, used to share and install the tone via `AI compose tone links » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#ai-compose-tone-links>`__
params.title: Human-readable tone name, up to `aicompose_tone_title_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-title-length-max>`__ UTF-8 characters long

AiComposeToneDefault.desc: A built-in, default `AI composer tone  <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`__, identified by a string identifier rather than by a numeric ID.

params.emoji_id: `Custom emoji ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`__ of the tone's icon
params.title: Localized, human-readable name of the tone
params.tone: String identifier of the built-in tone, to be passed to `inputAiComposeToneDefault <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputAiComposeToneDefault>`__

AiComposeToneExample.desc: An example showing how an `AI composer tone  <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`__ rephrases a message, used as a preview in the tone picker.

params.to: The same sample message after being rephrased with this tone

AttachMenuBot.desc:
Represents a `bot mini app that can be launched from the attachment/side menu  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__
At least one of the show_in_attach_menu or the show_in_side_menu flags will always be set.

params.icons: List of platform-specific static icons and animations to use for the attachment menu button
params.inactive: If set, before launching the mini app the client should ask the user to add the mini app to the attachment/side menu, and only if the user accepts, after invoking `messages.toggleBotInAttachMenu <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.toggleBotInAttachMenu>`__ the app should be opened.
params.peer_types: List of dialog types where this attachment menu entry should be shown
params.request_write_access: Whether the bot would like to send messages to the user.
params.show_in_attach_menu: Whether, when installed, an attachment menu entry should be shown for the Mini App.
params.show_in_side_menu: Whether, when installed, an entry in the main view side menu should be shown for the Mini App.
params.side_menu_disclaimer_needed: If inactive if set and the user hasn't previously accepted the third-party mini apps `Terms of Service <https://telegram.org/tos/mini-apps>`__ for this bot, when showing the mini app installation prompt, an additional mandatory checkbox to accept the `mini apps TOS <https://telegram.org/tos/mini-apps>`__ and a disclaimer indicating that this Mini App is not affiliated to Telegram should be shown.

AttachMenuBotIcon.desc: Represents an attachment menu icon for `bot mini apps  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__

params.name: One of the following values: note that animated icons must be played when the user clicks on the button, activating the bot mini app. default_static - Default attachment menu icon in SVG format placeholder_static - Default placeholder for opened Web Apps in SVG format ios_static - Attachment menu icon in SVG format for the official iOS app ios_animated - Animated attachment menu icon in TGS format for the official iOS app android_animated - Animated attachment menu icon in TGS format for the official Android app macos_animated - Animated attachment menu icon in TGS format for the official native Mac OS app ios_side_menu_static - Side menu icon in PNG format for the official iOS app android_side_menu_static - Side menu icon in SVG format for the official android app macos_side_menu_static - Side menu icon in PNG format for the official native Mac OS app

AttachMenuBotIconColor.desc: Represents an attachment menu icon color for `bot mini apps  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__

params.name: One of the following values: light_icon - Color of the attachment menu icon (light mode) light_text - Color of the attachment menu label, once selected (light mode) dark_icon - Color of the attachment menu icon (dark mode) dark_text - Color of the attachment menu label, once selected (dark mode)

AttachMenuBots.desc: Represents a list of `bot mini apps that can be launched from the attachment menu  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__

params.bots: List of `bot mini apps that can be launched from the attachment menu » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__
params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`__

AttachMenuBotsBot.desc: Represents a `bot mini app that can be launched from the attachment menu  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__

params.bot: Represents a `bot mini app that can be launched from the attachment menu » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__
params.users: Info about related users and bots

AttachMenuBotsNotModified.desc: The list of bot mini apps hasn't changed

AttachMenuPeerTypeBotPM.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in private chats with other bots (excluding the bot that offers the current attachment menu)

AttachMenuPeerTypeBroadcast.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in channels

AttachMenuPeerTypeChat.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in `groups and supergroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__

AttachMenuPeerTypePM.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in private chats with other users (not bots)

AttachMenuPeerTypeSameBotPM.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in the chat with the bot that offers it

params.amount: Amount of the bid in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.
params.date: Date when the bid was placed.

params.call_requests_disabled: Whether this session will accept phone calls
params.current: Whether this is the current session
params.date_active: When was the session last active
params.encrypted_requests_disabled: Whether this session will accept encrypted chats
params.hash: Identifier
params.official_app: Whether the session is from an official app
params.password_pending: Whether the session is still waiting for a 2FA password
params.unconfirmed: Whether the session is `unconfirmed, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auth#confirming-login>`__ for more info.

params.audio_preload_next: Whether to preload the next audio track when you're listening to music
params.file_size_max: Maximum size of other files to preload
params.large_queue_active_operations_max: A limit, specifying the maximum number of files that should be downloaded in parallel from the same DC, for files bigger than 20MB.
params.phonecalls_less_data: Whether to enable data saving mode in phone calls
params.photo_size_max: Maximum size of photos to preload
params.small_queue_active_operations_max: A limit, specifying the maximum number of files that should be downloaded in parallel from the same DC, for files smaller than 20MB.
params.stories_preload: Whether to preload `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`__; in particular, the first `documentAttributeVideo <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/documentAttributeVideo>`__.preload_prefix_size bytes of story videos should be preloaded.
params.video_preload_large: Whether to preload the first seconds of videos larger than the specified limit
params.video_size_max: Maximum size of videos to preload
params.video_upload_maxbitrate: Maximum suggested bitrate for uploading videos

params.photos: Whether photos should be autosaved to the gallery.
params.video_max_size: If set, specifies a size limit for autosavable videos
params.videos: Whether videos should be autosaved to the gallery.

AvailableEffect.desc:
Represents a `message effect  <https://core.telegram.org/api/effects>`__.
All long IDs except for id are `document <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/document>`__.ids from the containing `messages.availableEffects <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messages.availableEffects>`__ constructor.
See `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/effects>`__ for more info on how to use following fields.

params.effect_animation_id: If set, contains the actual animated effect `(TGS format ») <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#animated-stickers>`__. If not set, the animated effect must be set equal to the `premium animated sticker effect <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#premium-animated-sticker-effects>`__ associated to the animated sticker specified in effect_sticker_id (always different from the preview animation, fetched thanks to the `videoSize <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/videoSize>`__ of type f as specified `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#premium-animated-sticker-effects>`__).
params.effect_sticker_id: Contains the preview `animation (TGS format ») <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#animated-stickers>`__, used for the effect selection menu.
params.emoticon: Emoji corresponding to the effect, to be used as icon for the effect if static_icon_id is not set.
params.premium_required: Whether a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscription is required to use this effect.
params.static_icon_id: ID of the document containing the static icon (WEBP) of the effect.

AvailableReaction.desc: Animations associated with a message reaction

params.activate_animation: The animated sticker to show when the reaction is chosen and activated
params.appear_animation: The animated sticker to show when the user opens the reaction dropdown
params.around_animation: The animation that plays around the button when you press an existing reaction (played together with center_icon).
params.center_icon: The animation of the emoji inside the button when you press an existing reaction (played together with around_animation).
params.effect_animation: The background effect (still an animated sticker) to play under the activate_animation, when the reaction is chosen and activated
params.inactive: If not set, the reaction can be added to new messages and enabled in chats.
params.premium: Whether this reaction can only be used by Telegram Premium users
params.select_animation: The animated sticker to show when the user hovers over the reaction
params.title: Reaction description

BankCardOpenUrl.desc: Credit card info URL provided by the bank

Birthday.desc:
`Birthday <https://core.telegram.org/api/profile#birthday>`__ information for a user.
Also used to invite users to gift `Telegram Premium subscriptions  <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium#gifting-telegram-premium>`__ to other users with birthdays within a +1/-1 day time range, related to the current day.

Boost.desc: Info about one or more `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__ applied by a specific user.

params.gift: Whether this boost was applied because the channel/supergroup `directly gifted a subscription to the user <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__.
params.giveaway: Whether this boost was applied because the user was chosen in a `giveaway started by the channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__.
params.id: Unique ID for this set of boosts.
params.multiplier: If set, this boost counts as multiplier boosts, otherwise it counts as a single boost.
params.stars: Number of Telegram Stars distributed among the winners of the giveaway.
params.unclaimed: If set, the user hasn't yet invoked `payments.applyGiftCode <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.applyGiftCode>`__ to claim a subscription gifted `directly or in a giveaway by the channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__.
params.used_gift_slug: The created Telegram Premium gift code, only set if either gift or giveaway are set AND it is either a gift code for the currently logged in user or if it was already claimed.
params.user_id: ID of the user that applied the boost.

BotApp.desc: Contains information about a `direct link Mini App <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#direct-link-mini-apps>`__.

params.hash: Hash to pass to `messages.getBotApp <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getBotApp>`__, to avoid refetching bot app info if it hasn't changed.
params.short_name: bot mini app short name, used to generate `Direct Mini App deep links <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#direct-mini-app-links>`__.
params.title: bot mini app title.

params.placeholder_path: SVG placeholder logo, compressed using the same format used for `vector thumbnails » <https://core.telegram.org/api/files#vector-thumbnails>`__.

BotBusinessConnection.desc: Contains info about a `bot business connection <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__.

params.connection_id: Business connection ID, used to identify messages coming from the connection and to reply to them as specified `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__.
params.dc_id: ID of the datacenter where to send queries wrapped in a `invokeWithBusinessConnection <https://core.telegram.org/method/invokeWithBusinessConnection>`__ as specified `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__.
params.disabled: Whether this business connection is currently disabled
params.user_id: ID of the user that the bot is connected to via this connection.

BotCommand.desc: Describes a bot command that can be used in a chat

BotCommandScopeChatAdmins.desc: The specified bot commands will be valid only for chat administrators, in all `groups and supergroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.

BotCommandScopeChats.desc: The specified bot commands will be valid in all `groups and supergroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.

BotCommandScopeDefault.desc: The commands will be valid in all dialogs

BotCommandScopePeer.desc: The specified bot commands will be valid only in a specific dialog.

BotCommandScopePeerAdmins.desc: The specified bot commands will be valid for all admins of the specified `group or supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.

BotCommandScopePeerUser.desc: The specified bot commands will be valid only for a specific user in the specified `group or supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.

BotCommandScopeUsers.desc: The specified bot commands will only be valid in all private chats with users.

BotInfo.desc: Info about bots (available bot commands, etc)

params.commands: Bot commands that can be used in the chat
params.has_preview_medias: If set, the bot has some `preview medias for the configured Main Mini App, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#main-mini-app-previews>`__ for more info on Main Mini App preview medias.
params.menu_button: Indicates the action to execute when pressing the in-UI menu button for bots
params.privacy_policy_url: The HTTP link to the privacy policy of the bot. If not set, then the /privacy command must be used, if supported by the bot (i.e. if it's present in the commands vector). If it isn't supported, then `https://telegram.org/privacy-tpa <https://telegram.org/privacy-tpa>`__ must be opened, instead.
params.verifier_settings: This bot can `verify peers <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/verification>`__: this field contains more info about the verification the bot can assign to peers.

params.document: If type is document, the document to send
params.photo: If type is photo, the photo to send
params.send_message: Depending on the type and on the `constructor <https://core.telegram.org/type/BotInlineMessage>`__, contains the caption of the media or the content of the message to be sent instead of the media
params.title: Result title

BotInlineMessageMediaAuto.desc: Send whatever media is attached to the `botInlineMediaResult <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/botInlineMediaResult>`__

params.invert_media: If set, any eventual webpage preview will be shown on top of the message instead of at the bottom.

params.heading: For `live locations <https://core.telegram.org/api/live-location>`__, a direction in which the location moves, in degrees; 1-360.
params.proximity_notification_radius: For `live locations <https://core.telegram.org/api/live-location>`__, a maximum distance to another chat member for proximity alerts, in meters (0-100000).

params.currency: Three-letter ISO 4217 `currency <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies>`__ code, or XTR for `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.
params.shipping_address_requested: Set this flag if you require the user's shipping address to complete the order
params.title: Product name, 1-32 characters
params.total_amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

params.provider: Venue provider: currently only "foursquare" and "gplaces" (Google Places) need to be supported
params.title: Venue name
params.venue_id: Venue ID in the provider's database
params.venue_type: Venue type in the provider's database

BotInlineMessageMediaWebPage.desc: Specifies options that must be used to generate the link preview for the message, or even a standalone link preview without an attached message.

params.force_large_media: If set, specifies that a large media preview should be used.
params.force_small_media: If set, specifies that a small media preview should be used.
params.invert_media: If set, any eventual webpage preview will be shown on top of the message instead of at the bottom.
params.manual: If set, indicates that the URL used for the webpage preview was specified manually using `inputMediaWebPage <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputMediaWebPage>`__, and may not be related to any of the URLs specified in the message.
params.reply_markup: Reply markup for sending bot buttons
params.safe: If set, the link can be opened directly without user confirmation.
params.url: The URL to use for the link preview.

params.invert_media: If set, any eventual webpage preview will be shown on top of the message instead of at the bottom.

BotMenuButton.desc: `Bot menu button <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/menu>`__ that opens a `web app <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`__ when clicked.

params.text: Title to be displayed on the menu button instead of 'Menu'
params.url: URL of a `web app <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`__ to open when the user clicks on the button

BotMenuButtonCommands.desc: `Bot menu button <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/menu>`__ that opens the bot command list when clicked.

BotMenuButtonDefault.desc: Placeholder `bot menu button <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/menu>`__ never returned to users: see `the docs for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/menu>`__.

BotPreviewMedia.desc: Represents a `Main Mini App preview media, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#main-mini-app-previews>`__ for more info.

params.date: When was this media last updated.

params.bot_id: ID of the bot that verified this peer

params.can_modify_custom_description: Indicates whether the bot is allowed to set a custom description field for individual verified peers, different from the custom_description provided here.
params.company: The name of the organization that provides the verification
params.custom_description: An optional default description for the verification

BusinessAwayMessage.desc: Describes a `Telegram Business away message <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`__, automatically sent to users writing to us when we're offline, during closing hours, while we're on vacation, or in some other custom time period when we cannot immediately answer to the user.

params.offline_only: If set, the messages will not be sent if the account was online in the last 10 minutes.
params.recipients: Allowed recipients for the away messages.
params.schedule: Specifies when should the away messages be sent.
params.shortcut_id: ID of a `quick reply shorcut, containing the away messages to send, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`__.

BusinessAwayMessageScheduleAlways.desc: Always send `Telegram Business away messages <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`__ to users writing to us in private.

BusinessAwayMessageScheduleCustom.desc: Send `Telegram Business away messages <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`__ to users writing to us in private in the specified time span.

BusinessAwayMessageScheduleOutsideWorkHo.desc: Send `Telegram Business away messages <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`__ to users writing to us in private outside of the configured `Telegram Business working hours <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`__.

BusinessBotRecipients.desc: Specifies the private chats that a `connected business bot  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__ may receive messages and interact with.

params.contacts: Selects all private chats with contacts.
params.exclude_selected: If set, then all private chats except the ones selected by existing_chats, new_chats, contacts, non_contacts and users are chosen. Note that if this flag is set, any values passed in exclude_users will be merged and moved into users by the server, thus exclude_users will always be empty.
params.exclude_users: Identifiers of private chats that are always excluded.
params.non_contacts: Selects all private chats with non-contacts.

params.change_gift_settings: Whether the bot can change the privacy settings pertaining to gifts for the business account.
params.delete_received_messages: Whether the bot can delete received private messages in managed chats.
params.delete_sent_messages: Whether the bot can delete messages sent by the bot.
params.edit_bio: Whether the bot can edit the bio of the business account.
params.edit_name: Whether the bot can edit the first and last name of the business account.
params.edit_profile_photo: Whether the bot can edit the profile photo of the business account.
params.edit_username: Whether the bot can edit the username of the business account.
params.manage_stories: Whether the bot can post, edit and delete stories on behalf of the business account.
params.read_messages: Whether the bot can mark incoming private messages as read.
params.reply: Whether the bot can send and edit messages in private chats that had incoming messages in the last 24 hours.
params.sell_gifts: Whether the bot can convert regular gifts owned by the business account to Telegram Stars.
params.transfer_and_upgrade_gifts: Whether the bot can transfer and upgrade gifts owned by the business account.
params.transfer_stars: Whether the bot can transfer Telegram Stars received by the business account to its own account, or use them to upgrade and transfer gifts.
params.view_gifts: Whether the bot can view gifts and the amount of Telegram Stars owned by the business account.

BusinessChatLink.desc: Contains info about a `business chat deep link  <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#business-chat-links>`__ created by the current account.

params.message: Message to pre-fill in the message input field.
params.title: Human-readable name of the link, to simplify management in the UI (only visible to the creator of the link).
params.views: Number of times the link was resolved (clicked/scanned/etc...).

BusinessGreetingMessage.desc: Describes a `Telegram Business greeting <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#greeting-messages>`__, automatically sent to new users writing to us in private for the first time, or after a certain inactivity period.

params.no_activity_days: The number of days after which a private chat will be considered as inactive; currently, must be one of 7, 14, 21, or 28.
params.recipients: Allowed recipients for the greeting messages.
params.shortcut_id: ID of a `quick reply shorcut, containing the greeting messages to send, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`__.

params.title: Title of the introduction message (max `intro_title_length_limit » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#intro-title-length-limit>`__ UTF-8 characters).

BusinessLocation.desc: Represents the location of a `Telegram Business  <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#location>`__.

BusinessRecipients.desc:
Specifies the chats that can receive Telegram Business `away  <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`__ and `greeting  <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#greeting-messages>`__ messages.
If exclude_selected is set, specifies all chats that cannot receive Telegram Business `away  <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`__ and `greeting  <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#greeting-messages>`__ messages.

params.users: Only private chats with the specified users.

BusinessWeeklyOpen.desc:
A time interval, indicating the opening hours of a business.
Note that opening hours specified by the user must be appropriately validated and transformed before uploading them to the server, as specified `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`__.

params.end_minute: End minute in minutes of the week, 1 to 8*24*60 inclusively (8 and not 7 because this allows to specify intervals that, for example, start on Sunday 21:00 and end on Monday 04:00 (6*24*60+21*60 to 7*24*60+4*60) without passing an invalid end_minute < start_minute). See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`__ for more info.
params.start_minute: Start minute in minutes of the week, 0 to 7*24*60 inclusively.

BusinessWorkHours.desc: Specifies a set of `Telegram Business opening hours <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`__.

params.open_now: Ignored if set while invoking `account.updateBusinessWorkHours <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.updateBusinessWorkHours>`__, only returned by the server in `userFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/userFull>`__.business_work_hours, indicating whether the business is currently open according to the current time and the values in weekly_open and timezone.
params.timezone_id: An ID of one of the timezones returned by `help.getTimezonesList <https://core.telegram.org/method/help.getTimezonesList>`__.    The timezone ID is contained `timezone <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/timezone>`__.id, a human-readable, localized name of the timezone is available in `timezone <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/timezone>`__.name and the `timezone <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/timezone>`__.utc_offset field contains the UTC offset in seconds, which may be displayed in hh:mm format by the client together with the human-readable name (i.e. $name UTC -01:00).
params.weekly_open: A list of time intervals (max 28) represented by `businessWeeklyOpen » <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/businessWeeklyOpen>`__, indicating the opening hours of their business.

params.public_keys: Vector of public keys to use only during handshakes to `CDN <https://core.telegram.org/cdn>`__ DCs.

CdnPublicKey.desc: Public key to use only during handshakes to `CDN <https://core.telegram.org/cdn>`__ DCs.

params.admin_rights: Admin rights of the user in this channel (see `rights <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights>`__)

params.banned_rights: Banned rights of the user in this channel (see `rights <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights>`__)

params.call_active: Whether a group call or livestream is currently active

params.fake: If set, this `supergroup/channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__ was reported by many users as a fake or scam: be careful when interacting with it. Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.forum: Whether this supergroup is a `forum <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum>`__. Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.forum_tabs: `If set, enables the tabbed forum UI » <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum#tabbed-or-list-based-forum-ui>`__.
params.gigagroup: Whether this `supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__ is a gigagroupChanges to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.has_geo: Whether this chanel has a geoposition
params.has_link: Whether this channel has a linked `discussion group » <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion>`__ (or this supergroup is a channel's discussion group). The actual ID of the linked channel/supergroup is contained in `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__.linked_chat_id. Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.id: ID of the channel, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#peer-id>`__ for more info and the available ID range.
params.join_request: Whether a user's join request will have to be `approved by administrators <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#join-requests>`__, toggle using `channels.toggleJoinToSend <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.toggleJoinRequest>`__\Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.join_to_send: Whether a user needs to join the supergroup before they can send messages: can be false only for `discussion groups » <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion>`__, toggle using `channels.toggleJoinToSend <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.toggleJoinToSend>`__\Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.left: Whether the current user has left or is not a member of this channel
params.level: `Boost level <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__. Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.linked_monoforum_id: For channels with associated `monoforums <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__, the `monoforum <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__ ID. For `Monoforums <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__, the ID of the associated channel.
params.megagroup: Is this a supergroup? Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.monoforum: If set, this is a `monoforum » <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__, and the ID of the associated channel is specified in the linked_monoforum_id.
params.noforwards: Whether this channel or group is `protected <https://telegram.org/blog/content-protection-delete-by-date-and-more>`__, thus does not allow forwarding messages from it
params.restricted: Whether viewing/writing in this channel for a reason (see restriction_reason)
params.restriction_reason: Contains the reason why access to this channel must be restricted. Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.scam: This channel/supergroup is probably a scam Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.send_paid_messages_stars: If set, this supergroup or `monoforum <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__ has enabled `paid messages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`__, we might need to pay the specified amount of `Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ to send messages to it, depending on the configured exceptions: check `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__.send_paid_messages_stars to see if the currently logged in user actually has to pay or not, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`__ for the full flow (only set for the monoforum, not the associated channel).
params.signature_profiles: If set, messages sent by admins to this channel will link to the admin's profile (just like with groups).
params.slowmode_enabled: Whether slow mode is enabled for groups to prevent flood in chat. Changes to this flag should invalidate the local `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ cache for this channel/supergroup ID, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#full-info-database>`__ for more info.
params.stories_hidden: Whether we have `hidden all stories posted by this channel » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#hiding-stories-of-other-users>`__.
params.stories_hidden_min: If set, indicates that the stories_hidden flag was not populated, and its value must cannot be relied on; use the previously cached value, or re-fetch the constructor using `channels.getChannels <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.getChannels>`__ to obtain the latest value of the stories_hidden flag.
params.stories_max_id: Summary of the channel or supergroup's `active stories » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#recent-story-summaries>`__.
params.stories_unavailable: No stories from the channel are visible.
params.subscription_until_date: Expiration date of the `Telegram Star subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`__ the current user has bought to gain access to this channel.

ChannelFull.desc:
Full info about a `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel#channels>`__, `supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel#supergroups>`__ or `gigagroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel#gigagroups>`__.
When updating the `local peer database  <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers>`__, all fields from the newly received constructor take priority over the old constructor cached locally (including by removing fields that aren't set in the new constructor).

params.antispam: Whether `native antispam <https://core.telegram.org/api/antispam>`__ functionality is enabled in this supergroup.
params.available_min_id: Identifier of a maximum unavailable message in a channel due to hidden history.
params.banned_count: Number of users `banned <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights>`__ from the channel
params.blocked: Whether any anonymous admin of this supergroup was blocked: if set, you won't receive messages from `anonymous group admins » <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights#anonymous-admins>`__ in `discussion replies via @replies <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion>`__
params.boosts_applied: The number of `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__ the current user has applied to the current supergroup.
params.boosts_unrestrict: The number of `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__ this supergroup requires to bypass slowmode and other restrictions, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost#bypass-slowmode-and-chat-restrictions>`__ for more info.
params.bot_info: Info about bots in the channel/supergroup
params.call: Active or scheduled `video chat/livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`__ associated with this supergroup/channel
params.can_set_location: Can we set the geolocation of this group (for geogroups)
params.can_set_stickers: Can we `associate <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.setStickers>`__ a stickerpack to the supergroup?
params.can_set_username: Can we set the channel's username?
params.can_view_participants: Can we view the participant list?
params.can_view_revenue: If set, this user can view `ad revenue statistics » <https://core.telegram.org/api/revenue#revenue-statistics>`__ for this channel.
params.can_view_stars_revenue: If set, this user can view `Telegram Star revenue statistics » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#revenue-statistics>`__ for this channel.
params.default_send_as: Default peer used for sending messages to this channel
params.emojiset: `Custom emoji stickerset <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`__ associated to the current supergroup, set using `channels.setEmojiStickers <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.setEmojiStickers>`__ after reaching the appropriate boost level, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost#setting-a-custom-emoji-stickerset-for-supergroups>`__ for more info.
params.folder_id: `Peer folder ID, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/folders#peer-folders>`__
params.groupcall_default_join_as: Explicitly saved default peer used to join this supergroup/channel's `video chat/livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`__; if absent, the current user is used
params.hidden_prehistory: Is the history before we joined hidden to us?
params.kicked_count: Number of users `kicked <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights>`__ from the channel
params.linked_chat_id: ID of the linked `discussion chat <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion>`__ for channels (and vice versa, the ID of the linked channel for discussion chats).
params.main_tab: The main tab for the channel's profile, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/profile#tabs>`__ for more info.
params.migrated_from_chat_id: The chat ID from which this group was `migrated <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.migrated_from_max_id: The message ID in the original chat at which this group was `migrated <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.paid_media_allowed: Whether the current user can send or forward `paid media » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-media>`__ to this channel.
params.paid_messages_available: If set, admins may `enable enable paid messages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`__ in this supergroup.
params.paid_reactions_available: If set, users may send `paid Telegram Star reactions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions#paid-reactions>`__ to messages of this channel.
params.participants_count: Number of participants of the channel
params.participants_hidden: Whether the participant list is hidden.
params.pending_suggestions: A list of `suggested actions <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#suggestions>`__ for the supergroup admin, `see here for more info » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#suggestions>`__.
params.pinned_msg_id: Message ID of the last `pinned message <https://core.telegram.org/api/pin>`__
params.reactions_limit: This flag may be used to impose a custom limit of unique reactions (i.e. a customizable version of `appConfig.reactions_uniq_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#reactions-uniq-max>`__).
params.read_inbox_max_id: Position up to which all incoming messages are read.
params.read_outbox_max_id: Position up to which all outgoing messages are read.
params.recent_requesters: IDs of users who requested to join recently
params.restricted_sponsored: Whether ads on this channel were `disabled as specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost#disable-ads-on-the-channel>`__ (this flag is only visible to the owner of the channel).
params.send_paid_messages_stars: If set and bigger than 0, this supergroup, `monoforum <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__ or the monoforum associated to this channel has enabled `paid messages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`__ and we must pay the specified amount of `Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ to send messages to it, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`__ for the full flow. This flag will be set both for the monoforum and for `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__ of the associated channel). If set and equal to 0, the monoforum requires payment in general but we were exempted from paying.
params.slowmode_next_send_date: Indicates when the user will be allowed to send another message in the supergroup (unixtime)
params.slowmode_seconds: If specified, users in supergroups will only be able to send one message every slowmode_seconds seconds
params.stargifts_available: If set, users may send `Gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__ to this channel.
params.stargifts_count: Admins with `chatAdminRights <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/chatAdminRights>`__.post_messages rights will see the total number of received gifts, everyone else will see the number of gifts added to the channel's profile.
params.stats_dc: If set, specifies the DC to use for fetching channel statistics
params.stories_pinned_available: Whether this user has some `pinned stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#pinned-or-archived-stories>`__.
params.theme_emoticon: Emoji representing a specific chat theme
params.translations_disabled: Whether the `real-time chat translation popup <https://core.telegram.org/api/translation>`__ should be hidden.
params.ttl_period: Time-To-Live of messages in this channel or supergroup
params.view_forum_as_messages: Users may also choose to display messages from all topics of a `forum <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum>`__ as if they were sent to a normal group, using a "View as messages" setting in the local client.  This setting only affects the current account, and is synced to other logged in sessions using the `channels.toggleViewForumAsMessages <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.toggleViewForumAsMessages>`__ method; invoking this method will update the value of this flag.

Chat.desc:
Info about a group.
When updating the `local peer database <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers>`__, all fields from the newly received constructor take priority over the old constructor cached locally (including by removing fields that aren't set in the new constructor).
See `here  <https://github.com/tdlib/td/blob/077f71addad9db5d1a5692cc1255438793e75636/td/telegram/ChatManager.cpp#L5679>`__ for an implementation of the logic to use when updating the `local chat peer database <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers>`__.

params.admin_rights: `Admin rights <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights>`__ of the user in the group
params.call_active: Whether a group call is currently active
params.call_not_empty: Whether there's anyone in the group call
params.creator: Whether the current user is the creator of the group
params.date: Date of creation of the group
params.default_banned_rights: `Default banned rights <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights>`__ of all users in the group
params.id: ID of the group, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/peers#peer-id>`__ for more info and the available ID range.
params.left: Whether the current user has left the group
params.migrated_to: Means this chat was `upgraded <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__ to a supergroup
params.noforwards: Whether this group is `protected <https://telegram.org/blog/content-protection-delete-by-date-and-more>`__, thus does not allow forwarding messages from it
params.title: Title
params.version: Used in basic groups to reorder updates and make sure that all of them were received.

ChatAdminRights.desc: Represents the rights of an admin in a `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.

params.add_admins: If set, allows the admin to add other admins with the same (or more limited) permissions in the `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.ban_users: If set, allows the admin to ban users from the `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.change_info: If set, allows the admin to modify the description of the `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.delete_messages: If set, allows the admin to also delete messages from other admins in the `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.delete_stories: If set, allows the admin to delete `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`__ posted by the other admins of the `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.
params.edit_messages: If set, allows the admin to also edit messages from other admins in the `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.edit_stories: If set, allows the admin to edit `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`__ posted by the other admins of the `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.
params.invite_users: If set, allows the admin to invite users in the `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.manage_call: If set, allows the admin to create and administer `video chats/livestreams » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`__
params.manage_direct_messages: If set, allows the admin to manage the `direct messages monoforum » <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__ and `decline suggested posts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/suggested-posts>`__.
params.manage_ranks: If set, allows the admin to modify the `member tag » <https://core.telegram.org/api/rank>`__ of any user.
params.manage_topics: If set, allows the admin to create, delete or modify `forum topics » <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum#forum-topics>`__.
params.other: Set this flag if none of the other flags are set, but you still want the user to be an admin: if this or any of the other flags are set, the admin can get the chat `admin log <https://core.telegram.org/api/recent-actions>`__, get `chat statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__, get `message statistics in channels <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__, get channel members, see anonymous administrators in supergroups and ignore slow mode.
params.pin_messages: If set, allows the admin to pin messages in the `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.post_messages: If set, allows the admin to post messages in the `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__
params.post_stories: If set, allows the admin to post `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`__ as the `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__.

params.hide_read_marks: If this flag is set, the `inputPrivacyKeyStatusTimestamp <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPrivacyKeyStatusTimestamp>`__ key will also apply to the ability to use `messages.getOutboxReadDate <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getOutboxReadDate>`__ on messages sent to us. Meaning, users that cannot see our exact last online date due to the current value of the `inputPrivacyKeyStatusTimestamp <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPrivacyKeyStatusTimestamp>`__ key will receive a 403 USER_PRIVACY_RESTRICTED error when invoking `messages.getOutboxReadDate <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getOutboxReadDate>`__ to fetch the exact read date of a message they sent to us. The `userFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/userFull>`__.read_dates_private flag will be set for users that have this flag enabled.

GroupCall.desc:
Describes a `group call <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls>`__.
If the min flag is set, this is a partial (min) constructor: only a subset of its fields contains up-to-date information, and it must be merged into a previously cached non-min constructor as described below. If no full (non-min) constructor for this call was cached previously, the min constructor must be discarded.
When min is set, the following mandatory fields may be used: id, access_hash, participants_count and version. In addition, only the following conditional fields may be used if present, subject to the usual version check:
When min is set, the following fields must be ignored, keeping the values from the previously cached non-min constructor:
The join_date_asc flag is set only when the call is created and never changes afterwards, so it too is not applied from a min constructor.




	 | conference 

	 | rtmp_stream 

	 | listeners_hidden 

	 | title 

	 | messages_enabled 

	 | record_start_date and record_video_active 

	 | schedule_date 

	 | send_paid_messages_stars

params.can_change_join_muted: Whether the current user can change the value of the join_muted flag using `phone.toggleGroupCallSettings <https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.toggleGroupCallSettings>`__. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.can_change_messages_enabled: Whether the current user may enable or disable the `in-call message overlay » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`__. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.can_start_video: Whether you can start streaming video into the call. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.conference: Whether this is an E2E conference call.
params.creator: Whether the current user created this group call. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.default_send_as: Default peer displayed as the author of `live story comments and reactions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`__. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.invite_link: Invitation link for a `conference call » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`__. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.join_date_asc: Specifies the ordering to use when locally sorting by date and displaying in the UI group call participants. Set only when the call is created and never changed afterwards, so it is not applied from a min constructor.
params.join_muted: Whether the user should be muted upon joining the call. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.listeners_hidden: Whether the listeners list is hidden and cannot be fetched using `phone.getGroupParticipants <https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.getGroupParticipants>`__. The phone.groupParticipants.count and groupCall.participants_count counters will still include listeners.
params.messages_enabled: Whether the `in-call message overlay » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`__ is enabled
params.min: Whether this is a partial constructor that must be merged into a previously cached non-min constructor, following the rules described above.
params.record_video_active: Whether the group call is currently being recorded
params.rtmp_stream: Whether this call uses `RTMP livestream mode » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#rtmp-livestreams>`__
params.schedule_date: When is the call scheduled to start
params.schedule_start_subscribed: Whether we subscribed to the scheduled call. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.send_paid_messages_stars: Minimum Stars donation required from users other than the live story owner to send a `paid comment » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#paid-live-story-comments>`__; 0 or no value allows free comments
params.stream_dc_id: Media DC ID to use for `RTMP stream requests » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#playing-an-rtmp-livestream>`__. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.title: Group call title
params.unmuted_video_count: Number of people currently streaming video into the call. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.unmuted_video_limit: Maximum number of people allowed to stream video into the call. Must be ignored if the min flag is set.
params.version: Revision used to apply `group call updates » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#applying-group-call-updates>`__

For paid chats, use `stars_groupcall_message_limits » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stars-groupcall-message-limits>`__ to source limits according to the passed value of paid_message_stars, instead.

GroupCallParticipant.desc: Describes a group call participant and their current state, see `applying group call updates  <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#applying-group-call-updates>`__.
