params.file: File saved in parts using the method `upload.saveFilePart <https://core.telegram.org/method/upload.saveFilePart>`__
params.video: Square video for animated profile picture
params.video_emoji_markup: Animated sticker profile picture, must contain either a `videoSizeEmojiMarkup <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/videoSizeEmojiMarkup>`__ or a `videoSizeStickerMarkup <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/videoSizeStickerMarkup>`__ constructor.
params.video_start_ts: Floating point UNIX timestamp in seconds, indicating the frame of the video/sticker that should be used as static preview; can only be used if video or video_emoji_markup is set.

InputCheckPasswordSRP.desc: Constructor for checking the validity of a 2FA SRP password (see `SRP <https://core.telegram.org/api/srp>`__)

InputClientProxy.desc: Info about an `MTProxy <https://core.telegram.org/mtproto/mtproto-transports#transport-obfuscation>`__ used to connect.

params.folder_id: `Peer folder ID, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/folders#peer-folders>`__

InputDocument.desc: Defines a document for subsequent interaction.

InputDocumentFileLocation.desc: Document location (video, voice, audio, basically every type except photo)

params.thumb_size: Thumbnail size to download the thumbnail

InputEmojiStatusCollectible.desc:
An owned or `hosted collectible gift  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`__ as emoji status: can only be used in `account.updateEmojiStatus <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.updateEmojiStatus>`__, is never returned by the API.
Note that once set, the status will be returned to users as a `emojiStatusCollectible <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/emojiStatusCollectible>`__ constructor, instead (which cannot be passed to `account.updateEmojiStatus <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.updateEmojiStatus>`__, and must be converted to an `inputEmojiStatusCollectible <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputEmojiStatusCollectible>`__ first).

params.until: If set, the emoji status will be active until the specified unixtime.

InputEncryptedFile.desc: Sets forwarded encrypted file for attachment.

params.access_hash: Checking sum, value of access_hash parameter from `encryptedFile <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/encryptedFile>`__
params.id: File ID, value of id parameter from `encryptedFile <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/encryptedFile>`__

InputEncryptedFileBigUploaded.desc: Assigns a new big encrypted file (over 10 MB in size), saved in parts using the method `upload.saveBigFilePart <https://core.telegram.org/method/upload.saveBigFilePart>`__.

params.id: Random file id, created by the client
params.key_fingerprint: 32-bit imprint of the key used to encrypt the file

InputEncryptedFileLocation.desc: Location of encrypted secret chat file.

params.id: File ID, id parameter value from `encryptedFile <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/encryptedFile>`__

InputEncryptedFileUploaded.desc: Sets new encrypted file saved by parts using upload.saveFilePart method.

params.id: Random file ID created by client
params.key_fingerprint: 32-bit fingerprint of the key used to encrypt a file
params.md5_checksum: In case `md5-HASH <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MD5>`__ of the (already encrypted) file was transmitted, file content will be checked prior to use

InputFile.desc: Defines a file saved in parts using the method `upload.saveFilePart <https://core.telegram.org/method/upload.saveFilePart>`__.

params.id: Random file identifier created by the client
params.md5_checksum: In case the file's `md5-hash <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MD5#MD5_hashes>`__ was passed, contents of the file will be checked prior to use
params.name: Full name of the file

InputFileBig.desc: Assigns a big file (over 10 MB in size), saved in part using the method `upload.saveBigFilePart <https://core.telegram.org/method/upload.saveBigFilePart>`__.

params.id: Random file id, created by the client
params.name: Full file name

params.secret: Check sum to access the file

InputFileStoryDocument.desc: Used to `edit the thumbnail/static preview of a story, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#editing-stories>`__ for more info on the full flow.

params.folder_id: `Peer folder ID, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/folders#peer-folders>`__

params.bot_id: The bot that provides the game
params.short_name: The game's short name, usually obtained from a `game link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#game-links>`__

InputGeoPoint.desc: Defines a GeoPoint by its coordinates.

params.accuracy_radius: The estimated horizontal accuracy of the location, in meters; as defined by the sender.

InputGroupCallInviteMessage.desc: Identifies a `conference call  <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`__ using its `messageActionConferenceCall <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionConferenceCall>`__ invitation service message.

InputGroupCallSlug.desc:
Identify a `conference call  <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`__ using the slug from its invitation link.
This constructor can only be used for conference calls. It cannot be used for video chats/livestreams, live stories or any other group call type.

params.slug: Slug from the `conference link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#conference-links>`__.

InputGroupCallStream.desc: Identifies a media chunk of an RTMP-mode video chat, livestream or live story, see `playing an RTMP livestream  <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#playing-an-rtmp-livestream>`__.

params.call: RTMP-mode group call
params.scale: Specifies the duration of the media segment to fetch in milliseconds, by bitshifting 1000 to the right scale times: duration_ms := 1000 >> scale
params.time_ms: Timestamp of the chunk to fetch, in milliseconds
params.video_channel: `groupCallStreamChannel <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/groupCallStreamChannel>`__.channel value of the video channel to fetch; unified video uses channel 1. Omit together with video_quality to fetch audio
params.video_quality: Selected video quality (0 = lowest, 1 = medium, 2 = best)

InputInvoiceBusinessBotTransferStars.desc: Transfer stars from the balance of a user account `connected to a business bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__, to the balance of the `business bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#transferring-stars-from-a-business-account-to-the-business-bot>`__ for more info on the full flow.

params.bot: Always `inputUserSelf <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputUserSelf>`__.
params.stars: The number of stars to transfer.

InputInvoiceChatInviteSubscription.desc: Used to pay for a `Telegram Star subscription  <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`__.

params.hash: The `invitation link of the Telegram Star subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`__

InputInvoiceMessage.desc: An invoice contained in a `messageMediaInvoice <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaInvoice>`__ message or `paid media  <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-media>`__.

params.peer: Chat where the invoice/paid media was sent

InputInvoicePremiumAuthCode.desc: Used to pay for login codes, in case of high cost of SMS verification codes for the user's country/provider, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auth#paid-auth>`__ for more info.

InputInvoicePremiumGiftCode.desc: Used if the user wishes to start a channel/supergroup `giveaway <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ or send some `giftcodes <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ to members of a channel/supergroup, in exchange for `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__.

params.option: Should be populated with one of the giveaway options returned by `payments.getPremiumGiftCodeOptions <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getPremiumGiftCodeOptions>`__, see the `giveaways » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ documentation for more info.
params.purpose: Should be populated with `inputStorePaymentPremiumGiveaway <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputStorePaymentPremiumGiveaway>`__ for `giveaways <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ and `inputStorePaymentPremiumGiftCode <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputStorePaymentPremiumGiftCode>`__ for `gifts <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__.

InputInvoicePremiumGiftStars.desc: Used to gift a `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscription to another user, paying with `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.

params.months: Duration of the subscription in months, must be one of the options with currency == "XTR" returned by `payments.getPremiumGiftCodeOptions <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getPremiumGiftCodeOptions>`__.
params.user_id: Who will receive the gifted subscription.

InputInvoiceSlug.desc: An invoice slug taken from an `invoice deep link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#invoice-links>`__ or from the `premium_invoice_slug app config parameter  <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#premium-invoice-slug>`__

params.slug: The invoice slug

InputInvoiceStarGift.desc: Used to buy a `Telegram Star Gift, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__ for more info.

params.hide_name: If set, your name will be hidden if the destination user decides to display the gift on their profile (they will still see that you sent the gift)
params.include_upgrade: Also pay for an eventual upgrade of the gift to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__.
params.message: Optional message, attached with the gift. The maximum length for this field is specified in the `stargifts_message_length_max client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stargifts-message-length-max>`__.

InputInvoiceStarGiftAuctionBid.desc: Used to place a bid in a `collectible gift auction  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.

params.bid_amount: Total amount of the bid in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.
params.hide_name: If set, your name will be hidden if the destination peer decides to display the gift on their profile (they will still see that you sent the gift).    Must not be set when updating an existing bid, as the value cannot be changed for existing bids.
params.message: Optional message that will be attached with the gift if we end up winning this round: the maximum length for this field is specified in the `stargifts_message_length_max client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stargifts-message-length-max>`__.    Must not be set when updating an existing bid, as the value cannot be changed for existing bids.
params.peer: Identifier of the user or channel (only if `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__.stargifts_available is set) that will receive the gift.
params.update_bid: Must be set when increasing an already existing bid.

InputInvoiceStarGiftDropOriginalDetails.desc: Used to pay for for the removal of the `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`__ attribute from a collectible gift, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#dropping-the-original-details-of-an-upgraded-gift>`__ for the full flow.

params.stargift: The collectible gift whose `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`__ attribute should be removed.

InputInvoiceStarGiftPrepaidUpgrade.desc: `Separately prepay for the upgrade of a gift  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`__.

params.hash: The upgrade hash from `messageActionStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGift>`__.prepaid_upgrade_hash or `savedStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/savedStarGift>`__.prepaid_upgrade_hash.
params.peer: The peer that owns the gift.

InputInvoiceStarGiftResale.desc: Used to buy a `collectible gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__ currently up on resale, see `here <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`__ for more info on the full flow.

params.slug: Slug of the gift to buy.

InputInvoiceStarGiftTransfer.desc: Used to `pay to transfer a collectible gift to another peer <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`__, see the `gifts  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`__ documentation for more info.

params.stargift: The identifier of the received gift

InputInvoiceStarGiftUpgrade.desc: Used to `pay to upgrade a Gift to a collectible gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#upgrade-a-gift-to-a-collectible-gift>`__, see the `collectible gifts  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__ documentation for more info on the full flow.

params.keep_original_details: Set this flag to keep the original gift text, sender and receiver in the upgraded gift as a `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`__ attribute.
params.stargift: The identifier of the received gift to upgrade.

InputInvoiceStars.desc: Used to top up the `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ balance of the current account or someone else's account, or to start a `Telegram Star giveaway  <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`__.

InputKeyboardButtonRequestPeer.desc:
Prompts the user to select and share one or more peers with the bot using `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`__.
Use this constructor to send a `keyboardButtonRequestPeer <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/keyboardButtonRequestPeer>`__ button in a `reply keyboard <https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#keyboards>`__ in a private chat.
See `peer requests <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/buttons#peer-requests>`__ for the full flow.

params.button_id: Button ID, to be passed to `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`__.
params.max_quantity: Maximum number of peers that can be chosen.
params.name_requested: Set this flag to request the peer's name.
params.peer_type: Filtering criteria to use for the peer selection list shown to the user. The list should display all existing peers of the specified type, and should also offer an option for the user to create and immediately use one or more (up to max_quantity) peers of the specified type, if needed.
params.photo_requested: Set this flag to request the peer's photo (if any).
params.style: Button style, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/buttons#button-styles>`__ for more info on button styles.
params.username_requested: Set this flag to request the peer's @username (if any).

InputKeyboardButtonUrlAuth.desc:
Button to request a user to `authorize <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.acceptUrlAuth>`__ via URL using `Seamless Telegram Login <https://telegram.org/blog/privacy-discussions-web-bots#meet-seamless-web-bots>`__.
Use this constructor to send a `keyboardButtonUrlAuth <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/keyboardButtonUrlAuth>`__ button in an `inline keyboard <https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards>`__.

params.bot: Username of a bot, which will be used for user authorization. See `Setting up a bot <https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#setting-up-a-bot>`__ for more details. If not specified, the current bot's username will be assumed. The url's domain must be the same as the domain linked with the bot. See `Linking your domain to the bot <https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#linking-your-domain-to-the-bot>`__ for more details.
params.fwd_text: New text of the button in forwarded messages.
params.request_write_access: Set this flag to request the permission for your bot to send messages to the user.
params.style: Button style, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/buttons#button-styles>`__ for more info on button styles.
params.url: An HTTP URL to be opened with user authorization data added to the query string when the button is pressed. If the user refuses to provide authorization data, the original URL without information about the user will be opened. The data added is the same as described in `Receiving authorization data <https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#receiving-authorization-data>`__.NOTE: You must always check the hash of the received data to verify the authentication and the integrity of the data as described in `Checking authorization <https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#checking-authorization>`__.

InputKeyboardButtonUserProfile.desc:
Button that links directly to a user profile
Use this constructor to send a `keyboardButtonUserProfile <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/keyboardButtonUserProfile>`__ button in an `inline keyboard <https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards>`__.

params.style: Button style, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/buttons#button-styles>`__ for more info on button styles.

params.channel: The channel that posted the message
params.coordinates: The size and location of the media area corresponding to the location sticker on top of the story media.

InputMediaAreaVenue.desc: Represents a `location tag <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`__ attached to a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`__, with additional venue information.

params.coordinates: The size and location of the media area corresponding to the location sticker on top of the story media.
params.query_id: The query_id from `messages.botResults <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messages.botResults>`__, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`__ for more info.
params.result_id: The id of the chosen result, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`__ for more info.

params.emoticon: The emoji, for now ,  and  are supported

params.query: Text query or emoji that was used by the user to find this sticker or GIF: used to improve search result relevance.
params.spoiler: Whether this media should be hidden behind a spoiler warning
params.ttl_seconds: Time to live of self-destructing document, can be 0 to disable self-destruction, 0x7FFFFFFF to self-destruct the document immediately after it's played; otherwise self-destructs ttl_seconds after it's played.
params.video_timestamp: Start playing the video at the specified timestamp (seconds).

InputMediaDocumentExternal.desc: Document that will be downloaded by the telegram servers

params.spoiler: Whether this media should be hidden behind a spoiler warning
params.ttl_seconds: Time to live of self-destructing document, can be 0 to disable self-destruction, 0x7FFFFFFF to self-destruct the document immediately after it's played; otherwise self-destructs ttl_seconds after it's played.
params.video_timestamp: Start playing the video at the specified timestamp (seconds).

InputMediaEmpty.desc: Empty media content of a message.

params.heading: For `live locations <https://core.telegram.org/api/live-location>`__, a direction in which the location moves, in degrees; 1-360.
params.period: Validity period of the current location
params.proximity_notification_radius: For `live locations <https://core.telegram.org/api/live-location>`__, a maximum distance to another chat member for proximity alerts, in meters (0-100000)
params.stopped: Whether sending of the geolocation was stopped

params.payload: Bot-defined invoice payload, 1-128 bytes. This will not be displayed to the user, use for your internal processes.
params.photo: URL of the product photo for the invoice. Can be a photo of the goods or a marketing image for a service. People like it better when they see what they are paying for.
params.provider_data: JSON-encoded data about the invoice, which will be shared with the payment provider. A detailed description of required fields should be provided by the payment provider.
params.start_param: Unique `bot deep links start parameter <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#bot-links>`__. If present, forwarded copies of the sent message will have a URL button with a `deep link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#bot-links>`__ to the bot (instead of a Pay button), with the value used as the start parameter. If absent, forwarded copies of the sent message will have a Pay button, allowing multiple users to pay directly from the forwarded message, using the same invoice.
params.title: Product name, 1-32 characters

InputMediaPaidMedia.desc: `Paid media, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-media>`__ for more info.

params.payload: Bots only, specifies a custom payload that will then be passed in `updateBotPurchasedPaidMedia <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateBotPurchasedPaidMedia>`__ when a payment is made (this field will not be visible to the user)
params.stars_amount: The price of the media in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.

params.live_photo: Whether this is a live photo, i.e. a still photo paired with the short video clip captured alongside it
params.spoiler: Whether this media should be hidden behind a spoiler warning
params.ttl_seconds: Time to live of self-destructing photo, can be 0 to disable self-destruction, 0x7FFFFFFF to self-destruct the document immediately after it's played; otherwise self-destructs ttl_seconds after it's played.
params.video: The short video clip of the live photo

InputMediaPhotoExternal.desc: New photo that will be uploaded by the server using the specified URL

params.spoiler: Whether this media should be hidden behind a spoiler warning
params.ttl_seconds: Time to live of self-destructing photo, can be 0 to disable self-destruction, 0x7FFFFFFF to self-destruct the photo immediately after it's played; otherwise self-destructs ttl_seconds after it's played.

params.attached_media: Optional media attachment to display alongside the poll
params.correct_answers: 0-based indices of the correct answers in the answers vector (for quiz polls)
params.solution: Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style poll, 0-200 characters with at most 2 line feeds.
params.solution_entities: `Styled text message entities <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities>`__ for the solution explanation.
params.solution_media: Optional media attachment shown alongside the quiz solution explanation

params.peer: Peer where the story was posted

params.attributes: Attributes that specify the type of the document (video, audio, voice, sticker, etc.)
params.force_file: Force the media file to be uploaded as document
params.nosound_video: Whether to send the file as a video even if it doesn't have an audio track (i.e. if set, the `documentAttributeAnimated <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/documentAttributeAnimated>`__ attribute will not be set even for videos without audio)
params.spoiler: Whether this media should be hidden behind a spoiler warning
params.thumb: Thumbnail of the document, uploaded as for the file
params.ttl_seconds: Time to live of self-destructing document, can be 0 to disable self-destruction, 0x7FFFFFFF to self-destruct the document immediately after it's played; otherwise self-destructs ttl_seconds after it's played.
params.video_cover: Start playing the video at the specified timestamp (seconds).
params.video_timestamp: Start playing the video at the specified timestamp (seconds).

params.live_photo: Whether this is a live photo, i.e. a still photo paired with the short video clip captured alongside it
params.spoiler: Whether this media should be hidden behind a spoiler warning
params.ttl_seconds: Time to live of self-destructing photo, can be 0 to disable self-destruction, 0x7FFFFFFF to self-destruct the photo immediately after it's played; otherwise self-destructs ttl_seconds after it's played.
params.video: The short video clip of the live photo

InputMediaVenue.desc: Can be used to send a venue geolocation.

params.provider: Venue provider: currently only "foursquare" and "gplaces" (Google Places) need to be supported
params.title: Venue name
params.venue_id: Venue ID in the provider's database
params.venue_type: Venue type in the provider's database

InputMediaWebPage.desc: Specifies options that will be used to generate the link preview for the caption, or even a standalone link preview without an attached message.

params.force_large_media: If set, specifies that a large media preview should be used.
params.force_small_media: If set, specifies that a small media preview should be used.
params.optional: If not set, a WEBPAGE_NOT_FOUND RPC error will be emitted if a webpage preview cannot be generated for the specified url; otherwise, no error will be emitted (unless the provided message is also empty, in which case a MESSAGE_EMPTY will be emitted, instead).
params.url: The URL to use for the link preview.

InputMessageCallbackQuery.desc: Used by bots for fetching information about the message that originated a callback query

InputMessageEntityMentionName.desc: Message entity that can be used to create a user `user mention <https://core.telegram.org/api/mentions>`__: received mentions use the `messageEntityMentionName <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageEntityMentionName>`__ constructor, instead.

params.length: Length of message entity within message (in `UTF-16 code units <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities#entity-length>`__)
params.offset: Offset of message entity within message (in `UTF-16 code units <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities#entity-length>`__)
params.user_id: Identifier of the user that was mentioned

InputMessageReadMetric.desc: Read metric for a single message exposure, describing how long the message was visible in the chat viewport.

params.active_time_in_view_ms: Part of time_in_view_ms accumulated while the user is active
params.height_to_viewport_ratio_permille: round(max_message_height * 1000 / max_viewport_height), may exceed 1000 when the message is taller than the viewport
params.seen_range_ratio_permille: round(max_seen_vertical_range * 1000 / max_message_height), clamped to the 0–1000 range
params.time_in_view_ms: Total exposure time in milliseconds of at least one pixel of the message, after the 300 ms entry grace period
params.view_id: Random non-zero 64-bit ID generated for this exposure

InputMessageReplyTo.desc: Message to which the specified message replies to

params.id: ID of the message that replies to the message we need

InputMessagesFilterMusic.desc: Return only messages containing audio files

InputMessagesFilterMyMentions.desc: Return only messages where the current user was `mentioned <https://core.telegram.org/api/mentions>`__.

InputMessagesFilterPhotoVideo.desc: Filter for messages containing photos or videos.

InputMessagesFilterPoll.desc: Filter for poll messages, see `searching for polls  <https://core.telegram.org/api/poll#searching-for-polls>`__

InputMessagesFilterRoundVoice.desc: Return only round videos and voice notes

InputMessagesFilterVoice.desc: Return only messages containing voice notes

InputNotifyForumTopic.desc: Notifications generated by a `topic <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum#forum-topics>`__ in a `forum <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum>`__.

params.top_msg_id: `Topic ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum#forum-topics>`__

InputNotifyPeer.desc: Notifications generated by a certain user or group.

InputPasskeyCredentialFirebasePNV.desc: Alternative `passkey <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys>`__ credential that proves ownership of the account's phone number through a Firebase Phone Number Verification (PNV) token, used on official apps where a full WebAuthn `public-key passkey <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPasskeyCredentialPublicKey>`__ cannot be created, in a way similar to `Firebase SMS authentication  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auth>`__.

params.pnv_token: Firebase Phone Number Verification token attesting that the user controls the phone number associated with the account.

InputPasskeyCredentialPublicKey.desc: Public-key passkey credential used both for registration and for login, see `creating a passkey  <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#creating-a-passkey>`__ and `logging in with a passkey  <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#logging-in-with-a-passkey>`__ for the full flows.

params.id: id field of a `PublicKeyCredential <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PublicKeyCredential>`__, passed as-is without base64url-decoding when using the JSON representation
params.raw_id: rawId field of a `PublicKeyCredential <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PublicKeyCredential>`__, passed as-is without base64url-decoding when using the JSON representation

InputPasskeyResponseLogin.desc:
WebAuthn authentication response used when logging in with a passkey, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#logging-in-with-a-passkey>`__ for more info on the full flow.
Generated from the `AuthenticatorAssertionResponse <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AuthenticatorAssertionResponse>`__ object.

InputPrivacyKeyStatusTimestamp.desc:
Whether people will be able to see our exact last online timestamp.
Note that if we decide to hide our exact last online timestamp to someone (i.e., users A, B, C, or all users) and we do not have a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscription, we won't be able to see the exact last online timestamp of those users (A, B, C, or all users), even if those users do share it with us.
If those users do share their exact online status with us, but we can't see it due to the reason mentioned above, the by_me flag of `userStatusRecently <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/userStatusRecently>`__, `userStatusLastWeek <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/userStatusLastWeek>`__, `userStatusLastMonth <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/userStatusLastMonth>`__ will be set.

InputQuickReplyShortcut.desc: Selects a `quick reply shortcut <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`__ by name.

params.monoforum_peer_id: Must be set to the ID of the topic when replying to a message within a `monoforum topic <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`__.
params.poll_option: If set, sends the message as a `reply to a specific poll answer option » <https://core.telegram.org/api/poll#replying-to-poll-options>`__, containing the option bytes of the desired answer.
params.quote_entities: `Message entities for styled text <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities>`__ from the quote_text field.
params.quote_offset: Offset of the message quote_text within the original message (in `UTF-16 code units <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities#entity-length>`__).
params.quote_text: Used to quote-reply to only a certain section (specified here) of the original message. The maximum UTF-8 length for quotes is specified in the `quote_length_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#quote-length-max>`__ config key.
params.reply_to_msg_id: The message ID to reply to.
params.reply_to_peer_id: Used to reply to messages sent to another chat (specified here), can only be used for non-protected chats and messages.
params.todo_item_id: Can be set to reply to the specified item of a `todo list » <https://core.telegram.org/api/todo>`__.
params.top_msg_id: This field must contain the topic ID only when replying to messages in forum topics different from the "General" topic (i.e. reply_to_msg_id is set and reply_to_msg_id != topicID and topicID != 1).  If the replied-to message is deleted before the method finishes execution, the value in this field will be used to send the message to the correct topic, instead of the "General" topic.

InputStorePaymentAuthCode.desc: Indicates payment for a login code.

params.amount: Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.premium_days: Duration in days of the `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscription granted by this purchase, as indicated in `auth.sentCodePaymentRequired <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/auth.sentCodePaymentRequired>`__.premium_days.
params.restore: Set this flag to restore a previously made purchase.

InputStorePaymentGiftPremium.desc: Info about a gifted Telegram Premium purchase

params.amount: Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.user_id: The user to which the Telegram Premium subscription was gifted

InputStorePaymentPremiumGiftCode.desc: Used to gift `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscriptions only to some specific subscribers of a channel/supergroup or to some of our contacts, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ for more info on giveaways and gifts.

params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.boost_peer: If set, the gifts will be sent on behalf of a channel/supergroup we are an admin of, which will also assign some `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__ to it. Otherwise, the gift will be sent directly from the currently logged in user, and we will gain some extra `boost slots <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ for more info on giveaways and gifts.
params.users: The users that will receive the `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscriptions.

InputStorePaymentPremiumGiveaway.desc: Used to pay for a `giveaway, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ for more info.

params.additional_peers: Additional channels that the user must join to participate to the giveaway can be specified here.
params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.boost_peer: The channel/supergroup starting the giveaway, that the user must join to participate, that will receive the giveaway `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ for more info on giveaways.
params.countries_iso2: The set of users that can participate to the giveaway can be restricted by passing here an explicit whitelist of up to `giveaway_countries_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#giveaway-countries-max>`__ countries, specified as two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.
params.only_new_subscribers: If set, only new subscribers starting from the giveaway creation date will be able to participate to the giveaway.
params.prize_description: Can contain a textual description of additional giveaway prizes.
params.random_id: Random ID to avoid resending the giveaway
params.until_date: The end date of the giveaway, must be at most `giveaway_period_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#giveaway-period-max>`__ seconds in the future; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ for more info on giveaways.
params.winners_are_visible: If set, giveaway winners are public and will be listed in a `messageMediaGiveawayResults <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaGiveawayResults>`__ message that will be automatically sent to the channel once the giveaway ends.

InputStorePaymentPremiumSubscription.desc: Info about a Telegram Premium purchase

params.restore: Pass true if this is a restore of a Telegram Premium purchase; only for the App Store
params.upgrade: Pass true if this is an upgrade from a monthly subscription to a yearly subscription; only for App Store

InputStorePaymentStarsGift.desc: Used to gift `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ to a friend.

params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.stars: Amount of stars to gift
params.user_id: The user to which the stars should be gifted.

InputStorePaymentStarsGiveaway.desc: Used to pay for a `star giveaway, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`__ for more info.

params.additional_peers: Additional channels that the user must join to participate to the giveaway can be specified here.
params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.boost_peer: The channel/supergroup starting the giveaway, that the user must join to participate, that will receive the giveaway `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`__; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ for more info on giveaways.
params.countries_iso2: The set of users that can participate to the giveaway can be restricted by passing here an explicit whitelist of up to `giveaway_countries_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#giveaway-countries-max>`__ countries, specified as two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.
params.only_new_subscribers: If set, only new subscribers starting from the giveaway creation date will be able to participate to the giveaway.
params.prize_description: Can contain a textual description of additional giveaway prizes.
params.random_id: Random ID to avoid resending the giveaway
params.stars: Total number of Telegram Stars being given away (each user will receive stars/users stars).
params.until_date: The end date of the giveaway, must be at most `giveaway_period_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#giveaway-period-max>`__ seconds in the future; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`__ for more info on giveaways.
params.winners_are_visible: If set, giveaway winners are public and will be listed in a `messageMediaGiveawayResults <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaGiveawayResults>`__ message that will be automatically sent to the channel once the giveaway ends.

InputStorePaymentStarsTopup.desc: Used to top up the `Telegram Stars balance <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ of the current account.

params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.spend_purpose_peer: Should be populated with the peer where the topup process was initiated due to low funds (i.e. a bot for bot payments, a channel for paid media/reactions, etc); leave this flag unpopulated if the topup flow was not initated when attempting to spend more Stars than currently available on the account's balance.
params.stars: Amount of stars to topup

InputTakeoutFileLocation.desc: Used to download a JSON file that will contain all personal data related to features that do not have a specialized `takeout method <https://core.telegram.org/api/takeout>`__ yet, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/takeout>`__ for more info on the takeout API.

params.base_theme: Default theme on which this theme is based
params.message_colors: The fill to be used as a background for outgoing messages, in RGB24 format. If just one or two equal colors are provided, describes a solid fill of a background. If two different colors are provided, describes the top and bottom colors of a 0-degree gradient.If three or four colors are provided, describes a freeform gradient fill of a background.
params.message_colors_animated: If set, the freeform gradient fill needs to be animated on every sent message
params.outbox_accent_color: Accent color of outgoing messages in ARGB format
params.wallpaper: `inputWallPaper <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputWallPaper>`__ or `inputWallPaperSlug <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputWallPaper>`__ when passing wallpaper files for `image <https://core.telegram.org/api/wallpapers#image-wallpapers>`__ or `pattern <https://core.telegram.org/api/wallpapers#pattern-wallpapers>`__ wallpapers, `inputWallPaperNoFile <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputWallPaperNoFile>`__ with id=0 otherwise.

params.slug: Unique theme ID obtained from a `theme deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#theme-links>`__

InputUserEmpty.desc: Empty constructor, does not define a user.

InputWallPaperSlug.desc: `Wallpaper <https://core.telegram.org/api/wallpapers>`__ by slug (a unique ID, obtained from a `wallpaper link  <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#wallpaper-links>`__)

params.document: The audio file in question: must NOT be provided in secret chats, provide the title and performer fields instead.
params.performer: Song performer: should only be used in secret chats, in normal chats provide document instead, as it has more lax rate limits.
params.small: Used to return a thumbnail with 100x100 resolution (instead of the default 600x600)
params.title: Song title: should only be used in secret chats, in normal chats provide document instead, as it has more lax rate limits.
