ReplyKeyboardForceReply.desc: Force the user to send a reply

params.placeholder: The placeholder to be shown in the input field when the keyboard is active; 1-64 characters.
params.selective: Use this parameter if you want to show the keyboard to specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the text of the Message object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply (has reply_to_message_id), sender of the original message. Example: A user requests to change the bot's language, bot replies to the request with a keyboard to select the new language. Other users in the group don't see the keyboard.
params.single_use: Requests clients to hide the keyboard as soon as it's been used. The keyboard will still be available, but clients will automatically display the usual letter-keyboard in the chat – the user can press a special button in the input field to see the custom keyboard again.

params.selective: Use this flag if you want to remove the keyboard for specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the text of the Message object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply (has reply_to_message_id), sender of the original message.Example: A user votes in a poll, bot returns confirmation message in reply to the vote and removes the keyboard for that user, while still showing the keyboard with poll options to users who haven't voted yet

params.persistent: Requests clients to always show the keyboard when the regular keyboard is hidden.
params.placeholder: The placeholder to be shown in the input field when the keyboard is active; 1-64 characters.
params.resize: Requests clients to resize the keyboard vertically for optimal fit (e.g., make the keyboard smaller if there are just two rows of buttons). If not set, the custom keyboard is always of the same height as the app's standard keyboard.
params.selective: Use this parameter if you want to show the keyboard to specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the text of the Message object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply (has reply_to_message_id), sender of the original message.Example: A user requests to change the bot's language, bot replies to the request with a keyboard to select the new language. Other users in the group don't see the keyboard.
params.single_use: Requests clients to hide the keyboard as soon as it's been used. The keyboard will still be available, but clients will automatically display the usual letter-keyboard in the chat – the user can press a special button in the input field to see the custom keyboard again.

ReportResultAddComment.desc: The user should enter an additional comment for the moderators, and then `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`__ must be re-invoked, passing the comment to `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`__.message.

params.option: The `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`__ method must be re-invoked, passing this option to option
params.optional: Whether this step can be skipped by the user, passing an empty message to `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`__, or if a non-empty message is mandatory.

ReportResultChooseOption.desc: The user must choose one of the following options, and then `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`__ must be re-invoked, passing the option's option identifier to `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`__.option.

params.options: Available options, rendered as menu entries.
params.title: Title of the option popup

ReportResultReported.desc: The report was sent successfully, no further actions are required.

params.bot_admin_rights: If specified, allows only choosing channels where the bot is an admin with at least the specified admin rights.
params.creator: Whether to allow only choosing channels that were created by the current user.
params.has_username: If specified, allows only choosing channels with or without a username, according to the value of `Bool <https://core.telegram.org/type/Bool>`__.
params.user_admin_rights: If specified, allows only choosing channels where the current user is an admin with at least the specified admin rights.

params.bot_admin_rights: If specified, allows only choosing chats or supergroups where the bot is an admin with at least the specified admin rights.
params.bot_participant: Whether to allow only choosing chats or supergroups where the bot is a participant.
params.creator: Whether to allow only choosing chats or supergroups that were created by the current user.
params.forum: If specified, allows only choosing chats or supergroups that are or aren't `forums <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum>`__, according to the value of `Bool <https://core.telegram.org/type/Bool>`__.
params.has_username: If specified, allows only choosing channels with or without a username, according to the value of `Bool <https://core.telegram.org/type/Bool>`__.
params.user_admin_rights: If specified, allows only choosing chats or supergroups where the current user is an admin with at least the specified admin rights.

RequestPeerTypeCreateBot.desc: Used in a `keyboardButtonRequestPeer <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/keyboardButtonRequestPeer>`__ by a `manager bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/managed-bots>`__ to ask a user to create a new `managed bot  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/managed-bots>`__, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/buttons#requesting-a-managed-bot>`__ for more info.

params.bot_managed: If set, requests to create a managed bot; must always be set.
params.suggested_name: If set, the name to pre-fill in the managed bot creation flow
params.suggested_username: If set, the username to pre-fill in the managed bot creation flow

params.bot: Whether to allow choosing only bots.
params.premium: Whether to allow choosing only `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ users.

RequestedPeerChannel.desc:
Info about a `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__, shared by a user with the currently logged in bot using `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`__.
All fields except the ID are optional, and will be populated if present on the chosen channel/supergroup, according to the parameters of the requesting `inputKeyboardButtonRequestPeer <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputKeyboardButtonRequestPeer>`__.

RequestedPeerChat.desc:
Info about a `chat <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`__, shared by a user with the currently logged in bot using `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`__.
All fields except the ID are optional, and will be populated if present on the chosen chat, according to the parameters of the requesting `inputKeyboardButtonRequestPeer <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputKeyboardButtonRequestPeer>`__.

RequestedPeerUser.desc:
Info about a user, shared by a user with the currently logged in bot using `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`__.
All fields except the ID are optional, and will be populated if present on the chosen user, according to the parameters of the requesting `inputKeyboardButtonRequestPeer <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputKeyboardButtonRequestPeer>`__.

RequirementToContactEmpty.desc: This user can be freely contacted.

RequirementToContactPaidMessages.desc: This user requires us to pay the specified amount of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ to send them a message, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`__ for the full flow.

RequirementToContactPremium.desc: This user requires us to buy a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscription in order to contact them.

RestrictionReason.desc:
Restriction reason.
See `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/age-verification>`__ for the full flow to use for restricted or age-gated content.

params.platform: Platform identifier (ios, android, wp, all, etc.), can be concatenated with a dash as separator (android-ios, ios-wp, etc)
params.reason: Restriction reason (porno, terms, etc.). Ignore this restriction reason if it is contained in the `ignore_restriction_reasons » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#ignore-restriction-reasons>`__ client configuration parameter.
params.text: Error message to be shown to the user

SavedReactionTag.desc: Info about a `saved message reaction tag  <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages#tags>`__.

params.count: Number of messages tagged with this tag.
params.title: Custom tag name assigned by the user (max 12 UTF-8 chars).

SavedStarGift.desc: Represents a `gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__ owned by a peer.

params.can_craft_at: If set, this gift can be used for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`__ only starting from the specified unixtime.
params.can_export_at: If set, indicates that the current gift can't be `exported to the TON blockchain » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#withdraw-a-collectible-gift-to-the-ton-blockchain>`__ yet: the owner will be able to export it at the specified unixtime.
params.can_resell_at: If set, indicates that the current gift can't be `resold » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`__ yet: the owner will be able to put it up for sale at the specified unixtime.
params.can_transfer_at: If set, indicates that the current gift can't be `transferred » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`__ yet: the owner will be able to transfer it at the specified unixtime.
params.can_upgrade: Only set for non-collectible gifts, if they can be upgraded to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__.
params.collection_id: IDs of the `collections » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`__ that this gift is a part of.
params.convert_stars: For non-collectible gifts, the receiver of this gift may convert it to this many Telegram Stars, instead of displaying it on their profile page.
params.drop_original_details_stars: If set, the `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`__ attribute of this gift may be removed by paying the specified amount of stars, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#dropping-the-original-details-of-an-upgraded-gift>`__ for the full flow.
params.from_id: Sender of the gift (unset for anonymous gifts).
params.gift_num: Collectible number assigned to the gift, if already known.
params.msg_id: For gifts received by users, ID to use in `inputSavedStarGiftUser <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputSavedStarGiftUser>`__ constructors.
params.name_hidden: If set, the gift sender in from_id and the message are set only for the receiver of the gift.
params.pinned_to_top: Whether this gift is pinned on top of the user's profile page.
params.prepaid_upgrade_hash: `Hash to prepay for a gift upgrade separately » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`__.
params.refunded: This gift was upgraded to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__ and then re-downgraded to a regular gift because a request to refund the payment related to the upgrade was made, and the money was returned.
params.saved_id: For gifts received by channels, ID to use in `inputSavedStarGiftChat <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputSavedStarGiftChat>`__ constructors.
params.transfer_stars: If set, indicates that the gift can be `transferred » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`__ to another user by paying the specified amount of stars.
params.unsaved: If set, the gift is not pinned on the user's profile.
params.upgrade_separate: If set, someone already `separately pre-paid <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`__ for the upgrade of this gift.
params.upgrade_stars: Only for pre-paid non-collectible gifts, the number of Telegram Stars the sender has already paid to `convert the gift into a collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__ (this is different from the meaning of the flag in `messageActionStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGift>`__, where it signals the upgrade price for not yet upgraded gifts).

SearchPostsFlood.desc: Indicates if the specified `global post search  <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#posts-tab>`__ requires payment.

params.query_is_free: The specified query is free (and it will not use up free search slots).
params.remains: Remaining number of free search slots.
params.stars_amount: The number of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ to pay for each non-free search.
params.total_daily: Total number of daily free search slots.
params.wait_till: If there are no more search slots, specifies the unixtime when more search slots will be available.

SearchResultPosition.desc: Information about a message in a specific position

params.offset: 0-based message position in the full list of suitable messages

SearchResultsCalendarPeriod.desc:
Information about found messages sent on a specific day, used to split the messages in `messages.searchResultsCalendar <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messages.searchResultsCalendar>`__ constructors by days.
Multiple searchResultsCalendarPeriod constructors are returned in `messages.searchResultsCalendar <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messages.searchResultsCalendar>`__, each containing information about the first, last and total number of messages matching the filter that were sent on a specific day.

params.count: All messages that were sent on this day.
params.date: The day this object is referring to.
params.max_msg_id: Last message ID that was sent on this day.
params.min_msg_id: First message ID that was sent on this day.

SecureCredentialsEncrypted.desc: Encrypted credentials required to decrypt `telegram passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ data.

params.data: Encrypted JSON-serialized data with unique user's payload, data hashes and secrets required for EncryptedPassportElement decryption and authentication, as described in `decrypting data » <https://core.telegram.org/passport#decrypting-data>`__
params.hash: Data hash for data authentication as described in `decrypting data » <https://core.telegram.org/passport#decrypting-data>`__
params.secret: Secret, encrypted with the bot's public RSA key, required for data decryption as described in `decrypting data » <https://core.telegram.org/passport#decrypting-data>`__

SecureData.desc: Secure `passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ data, for more info `see the passport docs  <https://core.telegram.org/passport/encryption#securedata>`__

SecureFile.desc: Secure `passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ file, for more info `see the passport docs  <https://core.telegram.org/passport/encryption#inputsecurefile>`__

SecurePasswordKdfAlgoPBKDF2HMACSHA512ite.desc: PBKDF2 with SHA512 and 100000 iterations KDF algo

SecurePasswordKdfAlgoUnknown.desc: Unknown KDF algo (most likely the client has to be updated)

SecurePlainEmail.desc: Email address to use in `telegram passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__: `it must be verified, first  <https://core.telegram.org/passport/encryption#secureplaindata>`__.

SecurePlainPhone.desc: Phone number to use in `telegram passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__: `it must be verified, first  <https://core.telegram.org/passport/encryption#secureplaindata>`__.

params.files: Array of encrypted `passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ files with photos the of the documents
params.front_side: Encrypted `passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ file with the front side of the document
params.hash: Data hash
params.reverse_side: Encrypted `passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ file with the reverse side of the document
params.selfie: Encrypted `passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ file with a selfie of the user holding the document
params.translation: Array of encrypted `passport <https://core.telegram.org/passport>`__ files with translated versions of the provided documents

params.hash: Hash
params.type: Type of element which has the issue

SecureValueErrorData.desc: Represents an issue in one of the data fields that was provided by the user. The error is considered resolved when the field's value changes.

params.field: Name of the data field which has the error
params.type: The section of the user's Telegram Passport which has the error, one of `secureValueTypePersonalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/secureValueTypePersonalDetails>`__, `secureValueTypePassport <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/secureValueTypePassport>`__, `secureValueTypeDriverLicense <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/secureValueTypeDriverLicense>`__, `secureValueTypeIdentityCard <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/secureValueTypeIdentityCard>`__, `secureValueTypeInternalPassport <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/secureValueTypeInternalPassport>`__, `secureValueTypeAddress <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/secureValueTypeAddress>`__

SecureValueErrorFile.desc: Represents an issue with a document scan. The error is considered resolved when the file with the document scan changes.

SecureValueErrorFiles.desc: Represents an issue with a list of scans. The error is considered resolved when the list of files containing the scans changes.

SecureValueErrorFrontSide.desc: Represents an issue with the front side of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with the front side of the document changes.

SecureValueErrorReverseSide.desc: Represents an issue with the reverse side of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with reverse side of the document changes.

SecureValueErrorSelfie.desc: Represents an issue with the selfie with a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with the selfie changes.

SecureValueErrorTranslationFile.desc: Represents an issue with one of the files that constitute the translation of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file changes.

SecureValueErrorTranslationFiles.desc: Represents an issue with the translated version of a document. The error is considered resolved when a file with the document translation changes.

params.hash: Hash

SendAsPeer.desc: Indicates a peer that can be used to send messages

params.premium_required: Whether a Telegram Premium account is required to send messages as this peer

SendMessageCancelAction.desc: Invalidate all previous action updates. E.g. when user deletes entered text or aborts a video upload.

SendMessageChooseContactAction.desc: User is selecting a contact to share.

SendMessageEmojiInteraction.desc: User has clicked on an animated emoji triggering a `reaction, click here for more info  <https://core.telegram.org/api/animated-emojis#emoji-reactions>`__.

params.interaction: A JSON object with interaction info, `click here for more info » <https://core.telegram.org/api/animated-emojis#emoji-reactions>`__
params.msg_id: Message ID of the animated emoji that was clicked

SendMessageEmojiInteractionSeen.desc: User is watching an animated emoji reaction triggered by another user, `click here for more info  <https://core.telegram.org/api/animated-emojis#emoji-reactions>`__.

SendMessageGeoLocationAction.desc: User is selecting a location to share.

SendMessageRecordAudioAction.desc: User is recording a voice message.

SendMessageRecordRoundAction.desc: User is recording a round video to share

SendMessageTextDraftAction.desc: Used by bots to implement `live message streaming  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/ai#live-response-streaming>`__.

params.random_id: Live draft ID: used by graphical clients to slightly change the rendering behavior, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/ai#live-response-streaming>`__ for more info.
params.text: The contents of the live draft.

SendMessageUploadAudioAction.desc: User is uploading a voice message.

SendMessageUploadRoundAction.desc: User is uploading a round video

SpeakingInGroupCallAction.desc: User is currently speaking in the group call

params.additional_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsored message to be shown along with the message.
params.button_text: Label of the sponsored message button.
params.can_report: Whether this message can be `reported as specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#reporting-sponsored-messages>`__.
params.color: If set, the sponsored message should use the `message accent color » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`__ specified in color.
params.entities: `Message entities for styled text <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities>`__ in message.
params.max_display_duration: For `sponsored messages to show on channel videos » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#getting-sponsored-video-advertisements>`__, autohide the ad after after the specified amount of seconds.
params.min_display_duration: For `sponsored messages to show on channel videos » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#getting-sponsored-video-advertisements>`__, allow the user to hide the ad only after the specified amount of seconds.
params.photo: If set, contains a custom profile photo bubble that should be displayed for the sponsored message, like for messages sent in groups.
params.random_id: Message ID
params.recommended: Whether the message needs to be labeled as "recommended" instead of "sponsored"
params.sponsor_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsor to be shown along with the message.
params.title: Contains the title of the sponsored message.
params.url: Contains the URL to open when the user clicks on the sponsored message.

SponsoredMessageReportOption.desc: A `report option for a sponsored message  <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#reporting-sponsored-messages>`__.

params.additional_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsored message to be shown along with the peer.
params.random_id: ID of the sponsored peer, to be passed to `messages.viewSponsoredMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.viewSponsoredMessage>`__, `messages.clickSponsoredMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.clickSponsoredMessage>`__ or `messages.reportSponsoredMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.reportSponsoredMessage>`__ (the same methods used for `sponsored messages &raquo <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages>`__).
params.sponsor_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsor to be shown along with the peer.

StarGift.desc: Represents a `star gift, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__ for more info.

params.auction: If set, this is a collectible gift that can only be bought through a `collectible gift auction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.
params.auction_slug: Always set for gifts that can be bought on `auctions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__, contains the `auction deep link slug » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#auction-links>`__.
params.auction_start_date: Always set for gifts that can be bought on `auctions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__, contains the UNIX timestamp indicating when will the auction start (or when the auction started, if it points to the past).
params.availability_remains: For limited-supply gifts: the remaining number of gifts that may be bought.
params.availability_resale: The total number of (upgraded to `collectibles <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__) gifts of this type currently on `resale <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`__
params.availability_total: For limited-supply gifts: the total number of gifts that was available in the initial supply.
params.background: Default background palette for this gift type, used when rendering gift cards and previews before a specific collectible backdrop is chosen.
params.birthday: Whether this is a birthday-themed gift
params.convert_stars: The receiver of this gift may convert it to this many Telegram Stars, instead of displaying it on their profile page.convert_stars will be equal to stars only if the gift was bought using recently bought Telegram Stars, otherwise it will be less than stars.
params.first_sale_date: For sold out gifts only: when was the gift first bought.
params.gifts_per_round: Always set for gifts that can be bought on `auctions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__, contains the number of gifts of this kind that are distributed on every round.
params.last_sale_date: For sold out gifts only: when was the gift last bought.
params.limited: Whether this is a limited-supply gift.
params.limited_per_user: If set, the maximum number of gifts of this type that can be owned by a single user is limited and specified in per_user_total, and the remaining slots for the current user in per_user_remains.
params.locked_until_date: If set, the specified gift possibly cannot be sent until the specified date, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__ for the full flow.
params.peer_color_available: If set, collectible gifts of this type may be used to generate a `message color palette and pattern » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors#collectible-message-palettes>`__.
params.per_user_remains: Remaining number of gifts of this type that can be owned by the current user.
params.per_user_total: Maximum number of gifts of this type that can be owned by any user.
params.released_by: This gift was released by the specified peer.
params.require_premium: This gift can only be bought by users with a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscription.
params.resell_min_stars: The minimum price in `Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ for gifts of this type currently on `resale <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`__.
params.sold_out: Whether this gift sold out and cannot be bought anymore.
params.stars: Price of the gift in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.
params.title: Title of the gift
params.upgrade_stars: The number of Telegram Stars the user can pay to `convert the gift into a collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__.
params.upgrade_variants: Total number of possible `collectible variants » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#listing-all-possible-collectible-variants>`__ for this gift type.

StarGiftActiveAuctionState.desc: Contains info about `an auction where the user has placed a bid  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.

params.gift: The `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__ currently being distributed in the auction.
params.user_state: Auction state related to the current user (i.e. info about placed bids, won gifts and so on).

params.center_color: Color of the center of the backdrop in RGB24 format.
params.edge_color: Color of the edges of the backdrop in RGB24 format.
params.name: Name of the backdrop
params.pattern_color: Color of the `starGiftAttributePattern <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributePattern>`__ applied on the backdrop in RGB24 format.
params.text_color: Color of the text on the backdrop in RGB24 format.

StarGiftAttributeCounter.desc: Indicates the total number of gifts that have the specified attribute.

params.attribute: The attribute (just the ID, without the attribute itself).
params.count: Total number of gifts with this attribute.

StarGiftAttributeIdModel.desc: The ID of a model of a `collectible gift  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__.

StarGiftAttributeIdPattern.desc: The ID of a pattern of a `collectible gift  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__.

params.crafted: This model is reserved for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`__, and should be filtered out from regular upgrade previews.
params.name: Name of the model

StarGiftAttributeOriginalDetails.desc: Info about the sender, receiver and message attached to the original `gift  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__, before it was upgraded to a `collectible gift  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__.

params.message: Original message attached to the gift, if present.
params.sender_id: Original sender of the gift, absent if the gift was private.

StarGiftAttributePattern.desc: A `sticker <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers>`__ applied on the backdrop of a `collectible gift  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__ using a repeating pattern.

StarGiftAttributeRarity.desc: Exact rarity value for a collectible gift attribute.

params.permille: Probability of this attribute, in permille

StarGiftAttributeRarityEpic.desc: Represents epic collectible gift attribute rarity.

StarGiftAttributeRarityLegendary.desc: Represents legendary collectible gift attribute rarity.

StarGiftAttributeRarityRare.desc: Represents rare collectible gift attribute rarity.

StarGiftAttributeRarityUncommon.desc: Represents uncommon collectible gift attribute rarity.

StarGiftAuctionAcquiredGift.desc: Describes a gift that the current user won in an auction.

params.bid_amount: The amount in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ that was bid in order to obtain the gift.
params.gift_num: If set, the collectible number of the won gift among all collectibles of the same type. This field is optional because only auction collectibles won before this field was introduced in the API will not have this flag set.
params.message: Optional message that attached with the gift, passed when making the bid.
params.name_hidden: If set, your name will be hidden if the destination peer decides to display the gift on their profile (they will still see that you sent the gift).
params.peer: The peer that received the gift.
params.pos: The position of the gift in the auction.
params.round: The round number where the gift was obtained.

StarGiftAuctionRound.desc: Describes one or more `collectible gift auction rounds  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.

params.duration: Duration in seconds of the round(s).
params.num: This object describes all rounds starting from num up until next.num-1 inclusively (next is the next `StarGiftAuctionRound <https://core.telegram.org/type/StarGiftAuctionRound>`__).

StarGiftAuctionRoundExtendable.desc: Describes one or more extendable `collectible gift auction rounds  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.

params.duration: Duration in seconds of the round(s).
params.extend_top: The round(s) will be extended by extend_window if a bid changes the composition/order of the top extend_top bidders.
params.extend_window: The round(s) will be extended by this many seconds if a bid changes the composition/order of the top extend_top bidders.
params.num: This object describes all rounds starting from num up until next.num-1 inclusively (next is the next `StarGiftAuctionRound <https://core.telegram.org/type/StarGiftAuctionRound>`__).

params.bid_levels: Contains a sparse list of bids starting from the top bids, a more detailed description is available in `the docs <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.
params.end_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction will end
params.gifts_left: The remaining number of gifts that are yet to be distributed.
params.last_gift_num: The number of gifts that were distributed in the previous round (also used to compute the approximated index of the gift that the current user will receive, last_gift_num + approx_pos, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__ for more info).
params.min_bid_amount: Minumum allowed bid amount in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__: only applicable if the user hasn't made a bid yet, otherwise must be overridden to the value of `starGiftAuctionUserState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionUserState>`__.min_bid_amount (which will be set if and only if the user already made a bid to this auction).
params.next_round_at: UNIX timestamp indicating when the current auction round will end, distributing `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`__.gifts_per_round gifts to the top `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`__.gifts_per_round bidders.
params.start_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction will start (or when it started, if it's in the past).
params.top_bidders: User IDs of the top 3 bidders (the `user <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/user>`__ constructors will be returned as `min <https://core.telegram.org/api/min>`__ constructors in the containing object).
params.total_rounds: The total number of rounds in this auction.
params.version: Only apply incoming `starGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionState>`__ constructors if the received version is bigger than the locally cached version.

params.end_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction ended.
params.fragment_listed_count: Number of gifts from the auction currently being resold on `Fragment <https://fragment.com>`__.
params.fragment_listed_url: Only set if fragment_listed_count is set. If set, when the corresponding element is clicked in graphical clients, this URL should be opened.
params.listed_count: Number of gifts from the auction currently being resold on Telegram: if set, when the corresponding element is clicked in graphical clients, `payments.getResaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getResaleStarGifts>`__ should be invoked with the ID of the gift associated to this auction, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__ for more info.
params.start_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction started.

StarGiftAuctionStateNotModified.desc: Returned only by auction methods (never by updates) if the passed version is equal to the remote `auction  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.version, meaning auction information hasn't changed over the locally cached version.

StarGiftAuctionUserState.desc:
Contains information about the current user's state in an `auction  <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.
The bid_amount, bid_date, bid_peer and min_bid_amount flags of `starGiftAuctionUserState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionUserState>`__ will all be set if the user placed a bid in the auction.

params.acquired_count: Contains the number of gifts that were purchased so far in the auction by the current user.
params.bid_amount: Contains the amount of the placed bid in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.
params.bid_date: Contains a UNIX timestamp, indicating when the bid was placed.
params.bid_peer: Contains the peer that will receive the gift, if you end up winning this round
params.min_bid_amount: Contains the minumum allowed bid amount in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__, if set overrides `starGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionState>`__.min_bid_amount for the current user.
params.returned: If set, the placed bid was returned to the user, because it was outbid so much that it fell out of the top `starGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionState>`__.gifts_left positions, meaning that even if no new bids are placed, the user will never receive any gifts, so the bid was completely removed from the auction, and in order to participate again the user must manually make a new bid.

StarGiftBackground.desc: Contains the default background palette of a `gift type  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#listing-all-possible-collectible-variants>`__.

params.center_color: Center color of the background palette, in RGB24 format.
params.edge_color: Edge color of the background palette, in RGB24 format.
params.text_color: Text color to use on top of the background palette, in RGB24 format.

params.gifts_count: Number of gifts in the collection.
params.hash: Field to use instead of collection_id when generating the hash to pass to `payments.getStarGiftCollections <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getStarGiftCollections>`__.
params.icon: Optional icon for the collection, taken from the first gift in the collection.
params.title: Title of the collection.

StarGiftUnique.desc:
Represents a `collectible star gift, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__ for more info.
The sticker that represents the gift is contained in a `starGiftAttributeModel <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeModel>`__ object in attributes.

params.availability_issued: Total number of gifts of the same type that were upgraded to a collectible gift.
params.availability_total: Total number of gifts of the same type that can be upgraded or were already upgraded to a collectible gift.
params.burned: This gift was already used as an ingredient for `crafting another collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`__.
params.craft_chance_permille: Success probability, per 1000, contributed by this gift when it is used for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`__.
params.crafted: This collectible gift was obtained by `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`__, not by upgrading a regular gift.
params.gift_address: For `NFTs on the TON blockchain <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#withdraw-a-collectible-gift-to-the-ton-blockchain>`__, contains the address of the NFT (append it to the `ton_blockchain_explorer_url client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#ton-blockchain-explorer-url>`__ to obtain a link with information about the address).
params.gift_id: ID of the regular gift from which this gift was upgraded (all collectible gifts upgraded from the same gift will have the same gift_id, with different attributes).
params.host_id: If set, the gift is currently `hosted on the specified user or channel profile » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`__, while ownership remains with the TON wallet in owner_address.
params.id: Unique identifier of this collectible gift.
params.num: Unique identifier of this collectible gift among all (already upgraded) collectible gifts of the same type.
params.offer_min_stars: If set, you can `send a purchase offer for this gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`__: the minimum offer price is specified in this flag.
params.owner_address: For `NFTs on the TON blockchain <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#withdraw-a-collectible-gift-to-the-ton-blockchain>`__, contains the address of the owner (append it to the `ton_blockchain_explorer_url client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#ton-blockchain-explorer-url>`__ to obtain a link with information about the address).
params.owner_name: The name of the owner if neither owner_id nor owner_address are set.
params.released_by: This gift was released by the specified peer.
params.require_premium: This gift can only be bought by users with a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ subscription.
params.resale_ton_only: Whether the gift can be bought only using Grams.
params.slug: Slug that can be used to create a `collectible gift deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#collectible-gift-link>`__, or `elsewhere in the API where a collectible slug is accepted <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`__.
params.theme_available: A chat theme associated to this gift is available, `see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/themes#chat-themes>`__ for more info on how to use it.
params.theme_peer: The current chat where the associated `chat theme <https://core.telegram.org/api/themes#chat-themes>`__ is installed, if any (gift-based themes can only be installed in one chat at a time).
params.title: Collectible title.
params.value_currency: Currency for the gift's estimated price.
params.value_usd_amount: Estimated price of the gift in USD cents.

StarGiftUpgradePrice.desc: Indicates the price for a `gift upgrade  <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__ starting from a specific point in time.

params.date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the price will be in effect.

StarRefProgram.desc: Info about an `affiliate program offered by a bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`__

params.bot_id: ID of the bot that offers the program
params.commission_permille: An affiliate gets a commission of `starRefProgram <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starRefProgram>`__.commission_permille‰ `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ for every mini app transaction made by users they refer
params.daily_revenue_per_user: The amount of daily revenue per user in Telegram Stars of the bot that created the affiliate program. To obtain the approximated revenue per referred user, multiply this value by commission_permille and divide by 1000.
params.duration_months: An affiliate gets a commission for every mini app transaction made by users they refer, for duration_months months after a referral link is imported, starting the bot for the first time
params.end_date: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the affiliate program will be closed (optional, if not set the affiliate program isn't scheduled to be closed)

StarsAmount.desc: Describes a real (i.e. possibly decimal) amount of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.

params.amount: The integer amount of Telegram Stars.
params.nanos: The decimal amount of Telegram Stars, expressed as nanostars (i.e. 1 nanostar is equal to 1/1_000_000_000th (one billionth) of a Telegram Star). This field may also be negative (the allowed range is from -999_999_999 to 999_999_999).

params.amount: Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.extended: If set, the option must only be shown in the full list of topup options.
params.stars: Amount of Telegram stars.
params.store_product: Identifier of the store product associated with the option, official apps only.

StarsGiveawayOption.desc: Contains info about a `Telegram Star giveaway <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`__ option.

params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.default: If set, this option must be pre-selected by default in the option list.
params.extended: If set, this option must only be shown in the full list of giveaway options (i.e. they must be added to the list only when the user clicks on the expand button).
params.stars: The number of Telegram Stars that will be distributed among winners
params.store_product: Identifier of the store product associated with the option, official apps only.
params.winners: Allowed options for the number of giveaway winners.
params.yearly_boosts: Number of times the chat will be boosted for one year if the `inputStorePaymentStarsGiveaway <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputStorePaymentStarsGiveaway>`__.boost_peer flag is populated

StarsGiveawayWinnersOption.desc: Allowed options for the number of giveaway winners.

params.default: If set, this option must be pre-selected by default in the option list.
params.per_user_stars: The number of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ each winner will receive.
params.users: The number of users that will be randomly chosen as winners.

StarsRating.desc: Represents the profile's `star rating, see here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-rating>`__ for more info.

params.current_level_stars: The numerical value of the rating required for the current level.
params.level: The current level, may be negative.
params.next_level_stars: The numerical value of the rating required for the next level.
params.stars: Numerical value of the current rating.

params.next_withdrawal_at: Unixtime indicating when will withdrawal be available to the user. If not set, withdrawal can be started now.
params.overall_revenue: Total amount of earned Telegram Stars.
params.withdrawal_enabled: If set, the user may `withdraw <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#withdrawing-revenue>`__ up to available_balance stars.

params.bot_canceled: Set if this `bot subscription <https://core.telegram.org/api/subscriptions#bot-subscriptions>`__ was cancelled by the bot
params.can_refulfill: Whether we left the associated private channel, but we can still rejoin it using `payments.fulfillStarsSubscription <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.fulfillStarsSubscription>`__ because the current subscription period hasn't expired yet.
params.chat_invite_hash: Invitation link, used to renew the subscription after cancellation or expiration.
params.invoice_slug: For bot subscriptions, the `identifier <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#invoice-links>`__ of the subscription invoice
params.missing_balance: Whether this subscription has expired because there are not enough stars on the user's balance to extend it.
params.peer: Identifier of the associated private chat.
params.photo: For bot subscriptions, the photo from the subscription invoice
params.pricing: Pricing of the subscription in Telegram Stars.
params.title: For bot subscriptions, the title of the subscription invoice
params.until_date: Expiration date of the current subscription period.

params.amount: Price of the subscription in Telegram Stars.
params.period: The user should pay amount stars every period seconds to gain and maintain access to the channel. Currently the only allowed subscription period is 30*24*60*60, i.e. the user will be debited amount stars every month.

StarsTonAmount.desc: Describes an amount of Gram in nanograms (i.e. 1/1_000_000_000 of a Gram).

params.amount: The amount in nanograms.

Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.extended: If set, the option must only be shown in the full list of topup options.
params.stars: Amount of Telegram stars.
params.store_product: Identifier of the store product associated with the option, official apps only.

StarsTransaction.desc: Represents a `Telegram Stars or TON transaction  <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.

params.ads_proceeds_from_date: Indicates that this is payment for ad revenue from the specified unixtime (always set together with ads_proceeds_to_date).
params.ads_proceeds_to_date: Indicates that this is payment for ad revenue to the specified unixtime.
params.amount: Amount of Telegram Stars or TON.
params.bot_payload: Bot specified invoice payload (i.e. the payload passed to `inputMediaInvoice <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputMediaInvoice>`__ when `creating the invoice <https://core.telegram.org/api/payments>`__).
params.business_transfer: This transaction transfers stars from the balance of a user account `connected to a business bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__, to the balance of the business bot, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#transferring-stars-from-a-business-account-to-the-business-bot>`__ for more info.
params.description: For transactions with bots, description of the bought product.
params.floodskip_number: This transaction is payment for `paid bot broadcasts <https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once>`__.  Paid broadcasts are only allowed if the allow_paid_floodskip parameter of `messages.sendMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendMessage>`__ and other message sending methods is set while trying to broadcast more than 30 messages per second to bot users. The integer value returned by this flag indicates the number of billed API calls.
params.gift: This transaction was a gift from the user in peer.peer.
params.giveaway_post_id: ID of the message containing the `messageMediaGiveaway <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaGiveaway>`__, for incoming `star giveaway prizes <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`__.
params.msg_id: For `paid media transactions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-media>`__, message ID of the paid media posted to peer.peer (can point to a deleted message; either way, extended_media will always contain the bought media).
params.offer: Represents payment for a `collectible gift purchase offer » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`__.
params.paid_messages: This transaction is related to the reception or transmission of a `paid message » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`__.
params.peer: Source of the incoming transaction, or its recipient for outgoing transactions.
params.phonegroup_message: Represents payment for a paid text message sent during a `group call or live video stream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls>`__.
params.photo: For transactions with bots, photo of the bought product.
params.posts_search: Represents payment for a `paid global post search » <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#posts-tab>`__.
params.premium_gift_months: This transaction indicates the payment for a `gifted Telegram Premium subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium#gifting-telegram-premium>`__.
params.refund: Whether this transaction is a refund.
params.stargift: This transaction indicates a purchase or a sale (conversion back to Stars) of a `gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.
params.stargift_auction_bid: Represents payment for placing a `collectible gift auction bid » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`__.
params.stargift_drop_original_details: Represents payment for the removal of the `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`__ attribute from a gift, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#dropping-the-original-details-of-an-upgraded-gift>`__ for the full flow.
params.stargift_prepaid_upgrade: Represents payment for a `separate prepaid upgrade of a gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`__.
params.stargift_resale: This transaction is related to the `resale of a collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`__.
params.stargift_upgrade: This transaction pays for the upgrade of a gift to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`__.
params.starref_amount: For transactions made by `referred users <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`__, the amount of Telegram Stars received by the affiliate, can be negative for refunds.
params.starref_commission_permille: This transaction is the receival (or refund) of an `affiliate commission <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`__ (i.e. this is the transaction received by the peer that created the `referral link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#referral-links>`__, flag 17 is for transactions made by users that imported the referral link).
params.starref_peer: For transactions made by `referred users <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`__, the peer that received the affiliate commission.
params.subscription_period: The number of seconds between consecutive Telegram Star debiting for `Telegram Star subscriptions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`__.
params.title: For transactions with bots, title of the bought product.
params.transaction_date: If neither pending nor failed are set, the transaction was completed successfully, and this field will contain the point in time (Unix timestamp) when the withdrawal was completed successfully.
params.transaction_url: If neither pending nor failed are set, the transaction was completed successfully, and this field will contain a URL where the withdrawal transaction can be viewed.

StarsTransactionPeer.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction with another peer.

StarsTransactionPeerAPI.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction used to pay for paid API usage, such as `paid bot broadcasts <https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once>`__.

StarsTransactionPeerAds.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction used to pay for `Telegram ads as specified here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#paying-for-ads>`__.

StarsTransactionPeerAppStore.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction with the App Store, used when purchasing Telegram Stars through the App Store.

StarsTransactionPeerFragment.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction with `Fragment <https://fragment.com>`__, used when purchasing Telegram Stars through `Fragment <https://fragment.com>`__.

StarsTransactionPeerPlayMarket.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction with the Play Store, used when purchasing Telegram Stars through the Play Store.

StarsTransactionPeerPremiumBot.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction made using `@PremiumBot <https://t.me/premiumbot>`__ (i.e. using the `inputInvoiceStars <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputInvoiceStars>`__ flow described `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#buying-or-gifting-stars>`__).

StarsTransactionPeerUnsupported.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__ transaction that cannot be described using the current layer.

StatsAbsValueAndPrev.desc: Statistics value couple; initial and final value for period of time currently in consideration

StatsGraphAsync.desc: This `channel statistics graph <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__ must be generated asynchronously using `stats.loadAsyncGraph <https://core.telegram.org/method/stats.loadAsyncGraph>`__ to reduce server load

params.token: Token to use for fetching the async graph

StatsGraphError.desc: An error occurred while generating the `statistics graph <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__

StatsGroupTopAdmin.desc: Information about an active admin in a supergroup

params.banned: Number of banned users for `statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__ period in consideration
params.deleted: Number of deleted messages for `statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__ period in consideration
params.kicked: Number of kicked users for `statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__ period in consideration

StatsGroupTopInviter.desc: Information about an active supergroup inviter

params.invitations: Number of invitations for `statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__ period in consideration

StatsGroupTopPoster.desc: Information about an active user in a supergroup

params.avg_chars: Average number of characters per message
params.messages: Number of messages for `statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__ period in consideration

StatsPercentValue.desc:
`Channel statistics percentage <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats>`__.
Compute the percentage simply by doing part * total / 100

StickerPack.desc:
A stickerpack is a group of stickers associated to the same emoji.
It is not a sticker pack the way it is usually intended, you may be looking for a `StickerSet <https://core.telegram.org/type/StickerSet>`__.

params.archived: Whether this stickerset was archived (due to too many saved stickers in the current account)
params.channel_emoji_status: If set, this custom emoji stickerset can be used in `channel/supergroup emoji statuses <https://core.telegram.org/api/emoji-status>`__.
params.count: Number of stickers in pack
params.creator: Whether we created this stickerset
params.emojis: This is a custom emoji stickerset
params.hash: Hash
params.short_name: Short name of stickerset, used when sharing stickerset using `stickerset deep links <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#stickerset-links>`__.
params.text_color: Whether the color of this TGS custom emoji stickerset should be changed to the text color when used in messages, the accent color if used as emoji status, white on chat photos, or another appropriate color based on context.
params.thumb_document_id: Document ID of custom emoji thumbnail, fetch the document using `messages.getCustomEmojiDocuments <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getCustomEmojiDocuments>`__
params.title: Title of stickerset

StickerSetCovered.desc: Stickerset with a single sticker as preview

StickerSetFullCovered.desc:
Stickerset preview with all stickers of the stickerset included.
Currently used only for `custom emoji stickersets <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`__, to avoid a further call to `messages.getStickerSet <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getStickerSet>`__.

params.keywords: Keywords for some or every sticker in the stickerset.
params.packs: Emoji information about every sticker in the stickerset

StickerSetMultiCovered.desc: Stickerset, with multiple stickers as preview

StickerSetNoCovered.desc: Just the stickerset information, with no previews.

StoriesStealthMode.desc: Information about the current `stealth mode <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#stealth-mode>`__ session.

params.active_until_date: The date up to which stealth mode will be active.
params.cooldown_until_date: The date starting from which the user will be allowed to re-enable stealth mode again.

params.icon_photo: Photo from the first story of the album, if it's a photo.
params.icon_video: Video from the first story of the album, if it's a video.
params.title: Name of the album.

StoryFwdHeader.desc: Contains info about the original poster of a reposted story.

params.from: Peer that originally posted the story; will be empty for stories forwarded from a user with forwards privacy enabled, in which case from_name will be set, instead.
params.from_name: Will be set for stories forwarded from a user with forwards privacy enabled, in which case from will also be empty.
params.modified: Whether the story media was modified before reposting it (for example by overlaying a round video with a reaction).

params.caption: Story caption.
params.close_friends: Whether this story can only be viewed by `our close friends, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/privacy>`__ for more info
params.contacts: Whether this story can only be viewed by our contacts
params.edited: Indicates whether the story was edited.
params.fwd_from: For `reposted stories » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#reposting-stories>`__, contains info about the original story.
params.media_areas: List of media areas, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`__ for more info on media areas.
params.min: Full information about this story was omitted for space and performance reasons; use `stories.getStoriesByID <https://core.telegram.org/method/stories.getStoriesByID>`__ to fetch full info about this story when and if needed.
params.music: If set, the audio track played as background music for the story.
params.noforwards: Whether this story is `protected <https://telegram.org/blog/content-protection-delete-by-date-and-more>`__ and thus cannot be forwarded; clients should also prevent users from saving attached media (i.e. videos should only be streamed, photos should be kept in RAM, et cetera).
params.out: indicates whether we sent this story.
params.pinned: Whether this story is pinned on the user's profile
params.privacy: `Privacy rules <https://core.telegram.org/api/privacy>`__ indicating who can and can't view this story
params.public: Whether this story is public and can be viewed by everyone
params.selected_contacts: Whether this story can only be viewed by a select list of our contacts

StoryItemDeleted.desc: Represents a previously active story, that was deleted

StoryItemSkipped.desc: Represents an active story, whose full information was omitted for space and performance reasons; use `stories.getStoriesByID <https://core.telegram.org/method/stories.getStoriesByID>`__ to fetch full info about the skipped story when and if needed.

params.close_friends: Whether this story can only be viewed by `our close friends, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/privacy>`__ for more info
params.live: Whether this story is a `live video stream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`__.

StoryReaction.desc: How a certain peer reacted to a story

StoryReactionPublicForward.desc: A certain peer has forwarded the story as a message to a public chat or channel.

params.message: The message with the forwarded story.

StoryReactionPublicRepost.desc: A certain peer has reposted the story.

params.peer_id: The peer that reposted the story.

params.blocked: Whether we have `completely blocked <https://core.telegram.org/api/block>`__ this user, including from viewing more of our stories.
params.blocked_my_stories_from: Whether we have `blocked <https://core.telegram.org/api/block>`__ this user from viewing more of our stories.
params.date: When did the user view the story
params.reaction: If present, contains the reaction that the user left on the story
params.user_id: The user that viewed the story

StoryViewPublicForward.desc: A certain peer has forwarded the story as a message to a public chat or channel.

params.blocked: Whether we have `completely blocked <https://core.telegram.org/api/block>`__ this user, including from viewing more of our stories.
params.blocked_my_stories_from: Whether we have `blocked <https://core.telegram.org/api/block>`__ this user from viewing more of our stories.
params.message: The message with the forwarded story.

StoryViewPublicRepost.desc: A certain peer has reposted the story.

params.blocked: Whether we have `completely blocked <https://core.telegram.org/api/block>`__ this user, including from viewing more of our stories.
params.blocked_my_stories_from: Whether we have `blocked <https://core.telegram.org/api/block>`__ this user from viewing more of our stories.
params.peer_id: The peer that reposted the story.

StoryViews.desc: Aggregated view and reaction information of a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`__.

params.has_viewers: If set, indicates that the viewers list is currently viewable, and was not yet deleted because the story has expired while the user didn't have a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`__ account.
params.reactions: All reactions sent to this story
params.reactions_count: Number of reactions added to the story
params.recent_viewers: User IDs of some recent viewers of the story

params.accepted: Whether the suggested post was accepted.
params.rejected: Whether the suggested post was rejected.

TextAnchor.desc: Text linking to another section of the page

TextPhone.desc: Rich text linked to a phone number

params.webpage_id: If a preview was already generated for the page, the page ID

params.creator: Whether the current user is the creator of this theme
params.default: Whether this is the default theme
params.for_chat: Whether this theme is meant to be used as a `chat theme <https://telegram.org/blog/chat-themes-interactive-emoji-read-receipts>`__
params.slug: Unique theme ID
params.title: Theme name

params.message_colors: The fill to be used as a background for outgoing messages, in RGB24 format. If just one or two equal colors are provided, describes a solid fill of a background. If two different colors are provided, describes the top and bottom colors of a 0-degree gradient.If three or four colors are provided, describes a freeform gradient fill of a background.
params.message_colors_animated: If set, the freeform gradient fill needs to be animated on every sent message.
params.outbox_accent_color: Accent color of outgoing messages in ARGB format

params.name: Human-readable and localized timezone name.
params.utc_offset: UTC offset in seconds, which may be displayed in hh:mm format by the client together with the human-readable name (i.e. $name UTC -01:00).

params.completed_by: ID of the user that completed the item.
params.id: The ID of the completed item.
ID of the item, a positive (non-zero) integer unique within the current list.
params.title: Text of the item, maximum length equal to `todo_item_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#todo-item-length-max>`__.

params.others_can_append: If set, users different from the creator of the list can append items to the list.
params.others_can_complete: If set, users different from the creator of the list can complete items in the list.
params.title: Title of the todo list, maximum length equal to `todo_title_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#todo-title-length-max>`__.

params.rating: Rating as computed in `top peer rating » <https://core.telegram.org/api/top-rating>`__

TopPeerCategoryBotsApp.desc: Most frequently used `Main Mini Bot Apps <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#main-mini-apps>`__.

TopPeerCategoryBotsGuestChat.desc: Top `guest bots  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/guest-mode>`__, i.e. bots most frequently invoked as guests in chats.

TopPeerCategoryCorrespondents.desc: Users we've chatted most frequently with

TopPeerCategoryForwardChats.desc: Chats to which the users often forwards messages to

TopPeerCategoryForwardUsers.desc: Users to which the users often forwards messages to

params.count: Count of peers

UpdateAiComposeTones.desc: The list of saved `AI composer tones  <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`__ of the current user has changed, and should be refetched using `aicompose.getTones <https://core.telegram.org/method/aicompose.getTones>`__.

UpdateAttachMenuBots.desc: The list of installed `attachment menu entries  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`__ has changed, use `messages.getAttachMenuBots <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getAttachMenuBots>`__ to fetch the updated list.

UpdateAutoSaveSettings.desc: Media autosave settings have changed and must be refetched using `account.getAutoSaveSettings <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.getAutoSaveSettings>`__.

UpdateBotBusinessConnect.desc: Connecting or disconnecting a `business bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__ or changing the connection settings will emit an `updateBotBusinessConnect <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateBotBusinessConnect>`__ update to the bot, with the new settings and a connection_id that will be used by the bot to handle updates from and send messages as the user.

params.qts: New qts value, see `updates » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`__ for more info.

UpdateBotCallbackQuery.desc: A callback button was pressed, and the button data was sent to the bot that created the button

params.chat_instance: Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the callback button was sent. Useful for high scores in games.
params.game_short_name: Short name of a Game to be returned, serves as the unique identifier for the game
params.peer: Chat where the inline keyboard was sent
params.user_id: ID of the user that pressed the button

UpdateBotChatInviteRequester.desc: Someone has requested to join a chat or channel (bots only, users will receive an `updatePendingJoinRequests <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updatePendingJoinRequests>`__, instead)

params.invite: Chat invite link that was used by the user to send the `join request » <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#join-requests>`__
params.peer: The chat or channel in question
params.user_id: The user ID that is asking to join the chat or channel

UpdateBotCommands.desc: The `command set <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/commands>`__ of a certain bot in a certain chat has changed.

params.bot_id: ID of the bot that changed its command set

UpdateBotDeleteBusinessMessage.desc: A message was deleted in a `connected business chat  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__.

params.messages: IDs of the messages that were deleted.
params.qts: New qts value, see `updates » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`__ for more info.

UpdateBotEditBusinessMessage.desc: A message was edited in a `connected business chat  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__.

params.qts: New qts value, see `updates » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`__ for more info.
params.reply_to_message: The message that message is replying to.

UpdateBotGuestChatQuery.desc: Sent to `guest bots  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/guest-mode>`__ when a user invokes the bot as a guest in a chat. The bot should reply by invoking `messages.setBotGuestChatResult <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.setBotGuestChatResult>`__, see `here  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/guest-mode#handling-guest-queries-bot-side>`__ for more info.

params.message: The message that triggered the query
params.qts: `Persistent timestamp <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`__ (qts) of the update, used by bots to receive updates of this type
params.query_id: Query identifier, to be passed to `messages.setBotGuestChatResult <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.setBotGuestChatResult>`__ when replying
params.reference_messages: Additional context messages referenced by the triggering message (for example replied-to messages)

params.offset: Offset to navigate through results
params.peer_type: Type of the chat from which the inline query was sent.

UpdateBotInlineSend.desc: The result of an inline query that was chosen by a user and sent to their chat partner. Please see our documentation on the `feedback collecting <https://core.telegram.org/bots/inline#collecting-feedback>`__ for details on how to enable these updates for your bot.

params.geo: Optional. Sender location, only for bots that require user location
params.id: The unique identifier for the result that was chosen
params.msg_id: Identifier of the sent inline message. Available only if there is an inline keyboard attached to the message. Will be also received in callback queries and can be used to edit the message.
params.query: The query that was used to obtain the result
params.user_id: The user that chose the result

UpdateBotMenuButton.desc: The menu button behavior for the specified bot has changed

UpdateBotMessageReaction.desc: Bots only: a user has changed their reactions on a message with public reactions.

params.actor: The user that (un)reacted to the message.

UpdateBotMessageReactions.desc: Bots only: the number of reactions on a message with anonymous reactions has changed.

UpdateBotNewBusinessMessage.desc: A message was received via a `connected business chat  <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__.

params.qts: New qts value, see `updates » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`__ for more info.
params.reply_to_message: The message that message is replying to.

UpdateBotPrecheckoutQuery.desc: This object contains information about an incoming pre-checkout query.

params.currency: Three-letter ISO 4217 `currency <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies>`__ code, or XTR for `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`__.
params.info: Order info provided by the user
params.shipping_option_id: Identifier of the shipping option chosen by the user
params.total_amount: Total amount in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`__, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

UpdateBotPurchasedPaidMedia.desc: Bots only: a user has purchased a `paid media <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-media>`__.

params.payload: Payload passed by the bot in `inputMediaPaidMedia <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputMediaPaidMedia>`__.payload
params.qts: New qts value, see `updates » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`__ for more info.
params.user_id: The user that bought the media

UpdateBotShippingQuery.desc: This object contains information about an incoming shipping query.

UpdateBotStopped.desc: A bot was stopped or re-started.

params.qts: New qts value, see `updates » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`__ for more info.
params.stopped: Whether the bot was stopped or started

UpdateBotWebhookJSON.desc: A new incoming event; for bots only

UpdateBotWebhookJSONQuery.desc: A new incoming query; for bots only

UpdateBusinessBotCallbackQuery.desc: A callback button sent via a `business connection <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`__ was pressed, and the button data was sent to the bot that created the button.

params.chat_instance: Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the callback button was sent. Useful for high scores in games.
params.message: Message that contains the keyboard (also contains info about the chat where the message was sent).
params.reply_to_message: The message that message is replying to.
params.user_id: ID of the user that pressed the button

However, full peer information will not come bundled in updates, so the full peer cache (`channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`__) must be invalidated for channel_id when receiving this update.
